rows.output: Àwọn ará Masedóníà dibo nínú ìdìbò kan ní ọjọ́ Àbámẹ́rìndínlogójì lórí bóyá láti yí orúkọ rẹ̀ padà sí “Orílẹ̀èdè Àríwà Masedóníà,” ìgbésẹ̀ kan tí yóò yanjú ìforígbárí tí ó ti pé ọ̀pọ̀ ọdún pẹ̀lú Gíríìsì tí ó ti dènà ìwọlé rẹ̀ fún Ìparapọ̀ Yúróòpù àti NATO.
rows.reference: Àwọn eniyan Macedoni dìbò ninu ìbò oníbẹ́èni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ kan lọ́jọ́ Àìkú lórí bóyá kí wọ́n yí orúkọ rẹ̀ padà si ''Ilẹ̀ Olómìnira ti Àríwá Masidónià,'' ìgbésẹ kan tí yóò yanjú èdè-àìyedè atọdunmọdun kan pẹlu orilẹ-ede Gíríkì eyiti ó ti dínà mọ́ àwọn ìgbìyànjú rẹ̀ lati di ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ Àjọ Àwọn Orilẹ-ede Yuroopu àti NATO.

rows.output: Greece, tí ó ní ìpínlẹ̀ kan tí a ń pè ní Macedonia, sọ pé orúkọ agbègbè àríwà rẹ̀ jẹ́ ẹ̀tọ́ kan lórí ilẹ̀ rẹ̀, ó sì ti dènà ìbọ̀wọ̀ rẹ̀ sí NATO àti EU.

rows.output: Àwọn ìjọba méjèèjì náà fọwọ́ sí ìpinnu kan ní Okudu tí ó dá lórí orúkọ tuntun náà, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn alátakò ẹ̀yà orílẹ̀-èdè náà ń jiyàn pé ìyípadà náà yóò ba ìdánimọ̀ ẹ̀yà àwọn olùgbọ́ Slavic tó pọ̀ jùlọ ní orílẹ̀-èdè Macedonia jẹ́.

rows.output: Ìbéèrè lórí kíkọ̀rì náà ka: "Ǹjẹ́ o fẹ́ NATO àti ìbọ̀wọ̀ fún ìbọ̀wọ̀ pẹ̀lú Gíríìsì?"

rows.output: "A tarihi, tsohon mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai mashaya da coci a kowane lungu," in ji Mista Adams.

rows.output: "A yau, babu."

rows.output: "Yanzu mutane suna mu'amala ta hanyar daban" in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Mutane suna shaƙatawa ta wata hanya daban” a ranakun nan, injin shi.

rows.output: "An bar su a matsayin dakunan taro na unguwa inda mutane ke zuwa akai-akai."
rows.reference: “Mashayu yanzu ba ɗakuna ne da ke makwaɓta ba inda mutane ke zuwa a-kai-a-kai.”

rows.output: Game da majami'u, yana damuwa cewa kudi daga sayar da kadarori ba zai dore ba kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani, "kuma ba da jimawa ba za su dawo inda suka fara."
rows.reference: A game da majami’un, ya damu cewa kuɗin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba za su jima idan kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani ba, “kuma nan ba da jimawa ba ko daga baya za su dawo idan suka fara.”

rows.output: Coci, ya kara, za a iya maye gurbinsu da gine-gine na gidan zama da gidan haya da ke cike da irin mutanen da ba za su taimaka wa masu tsarkake wannan unguwar ba.
rows.reference: Ya ƙara da cewa, za a musanya majami’u da gine-ginen gidaje tare da manyan wurarene masu cike da irin mutane waɗanda ba za su taimaka ga sauran wuraren samun mafaka na makwaɓta.

rows.output: "Yawaitar mutanen da ke siyan gidan haya a cikin waɗannan gine-gine za su kasance fari," ya ce, "sannu kuma za su hanzarta ranar da waɗannan majami'u suka rufe gaba ɗaya saboda ba zai yiwu ba cewa yawancin mutanen da suka koma wajen gidan haya a cikin waɗannan gine-gine za su zama mambobin waɗannan majami'u."
rows.reference: “Mafi yawan mutane da za su sayi manyan wurare a cikin waɗannan gine-ginen za su kasance farar fata ne,” inji shi, “don haka kuwa za su gaggauta ranar da za a ce waɗannan majami’u sun rufe gaba ɗaya saboda akwai yiwuwar mafi yawanci waɗannan mutane da suka motsa cikin wadannan manyan wuraren su zama mambobi na waɗannan majami’u.”

rows.output: An gina dukkan majami'u biyu ne ta hannun al'ummomin fari kafin Harlem ya zama birni mai rinjaye - Majami'ar Al'umma a shekara ta 1870, St. Martin a shekara ta 1880.
rows.reference: Duka majami’un guda biyu farar fata ne suka gina su kafin Harlem ta zama alƙaryar baƙaƙen fata - Al’ummar da ke Alƙaryar a 1870, shekaru goma bayan St. Martin’s.

rows.output: Ƙungiyar Methodist ta asali ta bar wurin a cikin shekarun 1930.

rows.output: Ƙungiyar bishara ta bakar fata da keibin ta dauki ginin.

rows.output: An karɓi St. Martin's da wani cocin baƙar fata a karkashin jagorancin Rev. John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci yajin aikin masu siyarwa a kan titin 125, babbar hanya ta siyayya a Harlem, waɗanda suka ƙi daukan baƙar fata ko kuma su kara musu albashi.
rows.reference: Taron baƙaƙen fata masu ibada ne suka karɓe ragamar St. Martin’s a ƙarƙashin Rabaran John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci ‘yan kasuwa da su ƙaurace ma sayen kaya a kan layi na 125, wani babban layin yin sayayya a Harlem, wanda ya jajirce a wajen yin hayar ma’aikata ko tallafawa baƙaƙen fata.

rows.output: Wuta a shekarar 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma yayin da Father Johnson's parishioners suka fara shiri na sake gina shi, sun ba da umarnin carillon.
rows.reference: Wata gobara a cikin 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma kamar yadda mabiyan Fada Johnson suka yi shirye-shirye na sake ginin, su ne suka buɗe kayan kiɗan majami’ar.

rows.output: An yi wa Rev. David Johnson, ɗan Father Johnson da magaji a St. Martin's, ya yi alfahari da cewa "carillon shine agogunan talaka."
rows.reference: Rabaran David Johnson, dan Fada Johnson da wanda ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, a cikin alfahari ya kiran kayan kiɗan majami’ar “ƙararrawowin mutane talakawa.”

rows.output: Kwararre wanda ya buga carillon a watan Yuli ya kira shi wani abu daban: "Kwalliyar al'adu" da "kayan tarihi wanda ba za a iya maye gurbinsu ba."
rows.reference: Ƙwararren da ya kaɗa ƙararrawar a watan Yuli ya kira shi da wani abu daban: “Wata ajiyayyar dukiyar al’ada” da “wani kayan tarihi da ba za a iya maida gurbinsa ba.”

rows.output: Ƙwararren masanin, Tiffany Ng daga Jami'ar Michigan, ta kuma lura cewa ita ce motar farko a duniya da ta yi wasa da ɗan adam, Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya koma babban motar a cikin cocin Riverside shekaru 18 da suka gabata.

rows.output: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's ba ya maye gurbinshi.

rows.output: A cikin watanni da suka gabata, St. Martin's ya kasance wani labarin mai rikitarwa na masu zanen gine-gine da masu gine-gine, wasu da masu kula da cocin suka kawo, wasu kuma ta cocin Episcopal.
rows.reference: Abin da ya bayyana a St. Martin’s a ‘yan watanni da suka wuce ya zama wani labari mai ruɗarwa na masana zane da ‘yan kwangila, wasu da shugabannin majami’ar da ba su da ilimi suka kawo, sauran kuwa daga ikon babban limamin ‘yan Episcopal.

rows.output: Makami - majalisar da ke kula da al'umma, wanda ya kunshi shugabanni masu zaman kansu - sun rubuta ga diocese a watan Yuli da damuwar cewa diocese "zai yi ƙoƙarin watsar da farashi" ga makami, duk da cewa makami ba su shiga cikin daukan masanan gine-gine da masu aikin da diocese ta tura ba.
rows.reference: Sai kwamitin vestry ɗin - hukumar gudanar da yankin iyakar majami’ar, da ta haɗa da shugabanni da ba su da ilimi - sun rubuta wa babban limamin a Yuli da damuwowinsu cewa yankin iyakar majami’ar “zai nemi mika kuɗaɗen da aka kashe” zuwa kwamitin vestry ɗin, duk da cewa ba a sa kwamitin vestry ɗin ba a yin hayar masu zanen da ‘yan kwangilar da yankin iyakar majami’ar suka sa ba.

rows.output: Shin Sainsbury's na shiryawa don shiga kasuwar kayan kwalliyar Birtaniya
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana shirye-shiryen shiga kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya

rows.output: Sainsbury's yana fafatawa da Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams da shagon kayan ado mai salo na kayan kwalliya da ma'aikatan masuware.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana ɗaukan Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams tare da irin ɓangarorin shagon salon kwalliya da aka ɗauka masa ma’aikata da ƙwararrun masu ba da taimako.

rows.output: A matsayin wani ɓangare na babban tashin hankali zuwa kasuwar kyawu ta Birtaniya ta £2.8bn, wanda ke ci gaba da girma yayin da sayar da kayan ado da kayan masu amfani da su ke komawa baya, manyan sassan kyawu za a gwada su a cikin shaguna 11 a fadin kasar kuma a kai su wasu shaguna a shekarar gaba idan ya yi nasara.
rows.reference: A matsayin ɓangaren shiga cikin kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya ta Fam biliyan 2.8, wadda ke ci gaba da haɓaka duk da cewa cinikayyar ado da kayan gida ta sami koma baya, za a gwada manyan ɓangarorin kwalliya a shaguna 11 na kasar kuma a ɗauke su zuwa ƙarin shaguna a shekara mai zuwa idan abin ya ci wata nasara.

rows.output: Zuba jari a cikin kyawu ya zo ne yayin da shagunan sayayya ke neman hanyoyin amfani da sararin saman da aka yi amfani da su a baya don talbijin, microwave, da kayan gida.
rows.reference: Zuba jari a harkar kwalliya yana zuwa ne kamar yadda manyan shagunan sayar da kaya ke fafutukar hanyoyi don yin amfani da gurbin da babu kome da a da na ajiye talabijoji ne, da na’urorin dafa abinci da kayan gida.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ya ce zai ninka girman kayan kwalliyarsa zuwa samfuran 3,000, ciki har da alamomi kamar Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dr. PawPaw a karon farko.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s ya ce zai ruɓanya girma na abubuwan da zai samar na kwalliya har kusan kayayyaki 3,000, da suka haɗa da nau’uka kamar su Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dokta PawPaw a lokaci na farko.

rows.output: Ƙungiyoyinsu sun haɗa da L'Oreal, Maybelline da Burt's Bees, kuma za su sami ƙarin sarari tare da wuraren da aka yi wa lakabi iri ɗaya da waɗanda ke cikin shaguna kamar Boots.
rows.reference: Ranji-ranji da ke nan daga L'Oreal, Maybelline da Burt's Bees su ma za su sami gurbi masu yankin nau’uka iri ɗaya da waɗanda ake samu a cikin shaguna kamar Boots.

rows.output: Kantin sayayya kuma yana sake fara samar da layin kayan shafawa, don haka mafi yawan kayan suna da kyau ga masu cin ganyayyaki - wani abu da ake buƙata sosai daga masu siye masu shekaru.
rows.reference: Haka kuma babban shagon zai sake ƙaddamar da ranjinsa na kayan zamani saboda mafi yawancin kayayyakin su zama na abotar vegan - wani abin da ke samun ƙaruwar buƙata ga kananan masu yin ciniki.

rows.output: Bugu da ƙari, mai siyar da turare, The Fragrance Shop, za ta gwada shaguna a cikin shaguna biyu na Sainsbury, na farko da aka bude a Croydon, kudu da Landan, a makwanni da suka gabata, yayin da na biyu ya bude a Selly Oak, Birmingham, a karshen wannan shekara.
rows.reference: Kari a kan haka, mai sarin turare wato Shagon Turare zai gwada samar da rangwame a cikin shagunan Sainsbury's guda biyu, na farkonsu wanda ya buɗe a cikin Croydon, kudancin Landan, makon da ya wuce sa’an nan na biyun zai buɗe a cikin Selly Oak, Birmingham, daga baya cikin wannan shekarar.

rows.output: Siyan kan layi da kuma sauyawa zuwa siyan ƙananan kayan abinci a kowace rana a shagon da ke kusa da su yana nufin dole ne masu sayar da kayan abinci su yi ƙarin ƙo da mutane su ziyarta.
rows.reference: Sayan kaya ta yanar gizo da ‘yar matsawa zuwa sayan abinci kadan a kowace rana a shaguna masu samar da sauki na gida yana nufi ya zama dole manyan shagunan sayar da kayan su himmatu wajen jan hankalin mutane su ziyarta.

rows.output: An ce Mike Coupe, shugaban kamfanin Sainsbury, cewa shagunan za su yi kama da shagunan sashe a matsayin kamfanin na'ura mai kwakwalwa na supermarket, da ke ƙoƙarin yaƙi da masu rangwame Aldi da Lidl da ƙarin ayyuka da kayan da ba na abinci ba.
rows.reference: Mike Coupe, shugaban Sainsbury's, ya ce shagunan gefen za su ci gaba da zama kamar manyan shaguna masu ɓangarori kamar yadda jerin babban shagon ke ƙoƙarin gasa da masu rangwame Aldi da Lidl tare da karin ayyuka da wanda ba na abinci ba.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ya sanya wuraren Argos a cikin ɗaruruwan shaguna kuma ya gabatar da adadin wuraren da aka tsara tun lokacin da ya sayi duka jerin biyu shekaru biyu da suka wuce, wanda ya ce ya kara sayar da kayan abinci da kuma sa sayen ya fi riba.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana sa wuraren sayarwa na gefe na Argos a cikin ɗaruruwan shaguna haka kuma ya gabatar da wasu Habitats tun da ya saye gaba ɗaya jerinsu shekaru biyu da suka wuce, wanda yake cewa ya ƙara inganta cinikayyar kayan abinci inda kuma ya sa samun ya zama mai riba.

rows.output: An yi ƙoƙarin da kamfanin ya yi na sake fasalin sashensa na kayan kwalliya da na magani ya ci tura.
rows.reference: Ƙoƙarin da babban shagon ya yi na da a farfaɗo da ɓangarorin kwalliyar da magunguna ya ƙare babu nasara.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ta gwada haɗin gwiwa da Boots a farkon shekarun 2000, amma haɗin gwiwa ya ƙare bayan rikici kan yadda za a raba kudin shagon maganin da ke cikin shagunan su.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s ya gwada wani haɗin gwiwar kasuwanci tare da Boots a farkon shekaru na 2000, amma haɗuwar ta zo ƙarshe a bayan wani rikici na yadda za a raba kuɗaɗen da ke shigowa daga shagunan magani a cikin manyan shagunan nasa.

rows.output: Sabuwar dabarar ta zo ne bayan Sainsbury ta sayar da kasuwancinta na magani 281 ga Celesio, mai Lloyds Pharmacy, akan fam miliyan 125, shekaru uku da suka wuce.
rows.reference: Sabuwar dabarar ta zo ne a bayan Sainsbury's ya sayar da kasuwancin nasa na shaguna 281 na magunguna ga  Celesio, mamallakin jerin shagunan Lloyds Pharmacy, a kuɗi Fam miliyan 125.

rows.output: Ta ce Lloyds za ta taka rawa a cikin shirin, ta hanyar ƙara nau'ikan kayan kula da fata na alfarma da suka haɗa da La Roche-Posay da Vichy a cikin shaguna hudu.
rows.reference: Ya ce Llyods zai taka wata rawa a cikin shirin, ta yin ƙarin wani ranji da aka faɗaɗa na nau’ukan kayan kula da fatar jiki na morewa da suka haɗa da La Roche-Posay da Vichy a cikin shaguna huɗu.

rows.output: Paul Mills-Hicks, Daraktan kasuwanci na Sainsbury, ya ce: "Mun canza kamanninka da jin daɗi na shagonmu na kyau don inganta muhalli ga abokan cinikarmu.
rows.reference: Paul Mills-Hicks, daraktan ciniki na Sainsbury's ya ce: “Mun canza gani da yadda ake ji na ɓangarorin kwalliya don inganta yanayi ga abokan cinikinmu.

rows.output: Mun kuma saka hannun jari a kan abokan aiki da aka horar da su musamman don su kasance a shafukan don ba da shawara.
rows.reference: Mun kuma zuba jari a abokan aikinmu da suka sami horarwa ta musamman waɗanda za su kasance a kusa wajen ba da shawara.

rows.output: An tsara layinmu na alamomin don dacewa da kowane bukata kuma yanayin da ake sha'awa da kuma wurin da ake samu sauƙin isa suna nufin yanzu muna zama wurin sha'awar kayan kwalliya wanda ke kalubalantar hanyar da ta gabata ta siyayya."
rows.reference: An tsara ranjinmu na nau’uka ne don dacewa da kowace buƙata kuma yanayin mai ƙayatarwa da wuraren da ke sauki wanda ke nufin wani wurin zuwa na kwalliya mai jan hankali da ke ƙalubalantar tsohuwar hanya ta sayan kaya.”

rows.output: Duk da cewa sun samu nasara mai muhimmanci, duk da haka jam'iyyar pro-independence ta Catalonia sun yi fama wajen ci gaba da samun karfin guiwa a wannan shekara, inda da yawa daga cikin shugabanninsu da aka fi sani da su sun yi gurguzu a waje ko kuma a tsare a jiran shari'a bisa zarginsu da shiryawaar gudanar da zaben da kuma shelar 'yancin kai.

rows.output: Joan Puig, mai shekaru 42 mai aikin gyara motoci, wanda ke rubuta zanga-zanga a goyon bayan 'yan sanda a wayarsa, ya ce an kara ta'azzara rikici ta hanyar 'yan siyasa a bangarori biyu.

rows.output: Sauran yankuna na yankin Hamadar Kudu da yamma, ciki har da tsakiyar Rockies da Babbar Kogunan, suna iya samun inci 1 zuwa 2, tare da jimlar da ba a iya gani ba har zuwa inci 4.
rows.reference: Sauran yankunan na Desert Southwest da suka hada da tsakiyar Rockies da Great Basin ba mamaki su sami incina 1 zuwa 2 tare da jimillar da ba ta ciki har kusan incina 4 da zai yiwu.

rows.output: Ga waɗanda ba su cikin haɗarin ambaliya, ruwan Rosa na iya zama albarka tun da yankin ya yi fama da fari.
rows.reference: Ga waɗanda ba sa cikin haɗarin ambaliyar mai tasowar, ruwan saman na Rosa ɗin ƙila ya zama wata rahama tun da yankin yana fama da fari.

rows.output: Duk da cewa ambaliya babbar damuwa ce, wasu daga cikin wannan ruwan sama za su iya zama masu amfani tun da kudu maso yamma na fama da fari a yanzu.
rows.reference: Kodayake ambaliyar ruwa wani abin damuwa ne sosai, wani daga cikin wannan ruwan saman zai fa’idantar tun da Kudu-maso-yamma a yanzu yana ganin yanayi na fari.

rows.output: Bisa ga U.S. Drought Monitor, kusan kashi 40 cikin 100 na Arizona na fuskantar aƙalla matsanancin fari, mafi girma a cikin nau'in, kamar yadda weather.com ya ruwaito.
rows.reference: A cewar Hukumar Kula da Fari ta Amurka, kawai sama da kashi 40 cikin ɗari ne na Arizona ke ganin aƙalla matsanancin fari, nau’i mafi girma na biyu,” inji rahoto na weather.com.

rows.output: Da farko, hanyar guguwa ta Rosa ta kai ga ƙasa a gefen tsibirin Baja California na Mexico.
rows.reference: Da farko, hanyar Guguwar Rosa ta wuce ne zuwa faɗuwa a ƙasa ta cikin zirin Baja California na Mexico.

rows.output: Rosa, har yanzu tana da ƙarfi a ranar Lahadi da iska mafi girma na mil 85 a sa'a, tana da nisa mil 385 kudu da Punta Eugenia, Mexico kuma tana tafiya arewa da mil 12 a sa'a.
rows.reference: Rosa, har yanzu tana da ƙarfin ba babbar iskar guguwa da safiyar Lahadi tare da gayar iskoki na mil 85 a kowace sa’a, shi ne mil 385 kudu da Punta Eugenia, Mexico kuma tana matsawa a mil 12 kowace sa’a.

rows.output: Guguwar tana fuskantar ruwan sanyi a cikin Tekun Pacific kuma saboda haka tana rage karfi.
rows.reference: Cidar tana haɗuwa da ruwa mai sanyi a cikin tekun Pacific don haka tana sauka.

rows.output: Don haka, ana sa ran za ta sauka a Mexico a matsayin guguwa a cikin yamma a rana ko maraice a ranar Litinin.
rows.reference: A saboda haka, ana tsammani za ta sauka a ƙasa a cikin Mexico a ƙarfin cidar lokacin zafi da cikin rana ko yamma a ranar Litinin.

rows.output: Ruwan sama a wasu sassan Mexico na iya zama mai yawa, wanda ke haifar da babbar barazana ta ambaliya.
rows.reference: Ba mamaki ruwan sama a faɗin sassa na Mexico ya zama da yawa, yana mai haifar da wani haɗarin ambaliya mai yawa.

rows.output: "Ana sa ran ruwan sama na inci 3 zuwa 6 a cikin Baja California zuwa arewa maso yammacin Sonora, tare da har zuwa inci 10 mai yiwuwa," weather.com ya ruwaito.
rows.reference: “Ana tsammanin jimillar ruwan sama na incina 3 zuwa 6 daga Baja California zuwa cikin kudu-maso-yammacin Sonora,” a cewar rahoton weather.com.

rows.output: Rosa za ta bi arewa a cikin Mexico a matsayin guguwar tropikal kafin ta kai kan iyaka da Arizona da safe a ranar Talata a matsayin guguwar tropikal, wanda za ta bi ta Arizona da zuwa kudu maso yammacin Utah da daddare a ranar Talata.
rows.reference: Daga nan Rosa za ta bi arewa ta faɗin Mexico a matsayin cidar iskar zafi kafin isa iyakar Arizona a cikin farkon sa’o’in safiyar Talata a matsayin raguwar lokacin zafi, inda daga nan za ta bi sama ta cikin Arizona da kuma zuwa cikin kudancin Itah da ƙarshen Talata da dare.

rows.output: "Haɗarin da ake sa ran daga Rosa ko ragowanta shi ne ruwan sama mai yawa a California ta Yamma, arewa maso yammacin Sonora, da kuma yankin hamadar Amurka ta Kudu maso Yamma," in ji Cibiyar Hurricane ta Kasa.
rows.reference: “Babban haɗari da ake tsammani daga Rosa ko abubuwanta da za su saura shi ne ruwan sama sosai a cikin Baja California, arewa-maso-yammacin Sonora, da Amurka Desert Southwest," inji Cibiyar Iskar Guguwa ta Ƙasa.

rows.output: Ana sa ran waɗannan ruwan sama za su haifar da ambaliya mai hatsari da kuma guntun duwatsu a cikin hamadai, da kuma ambaliya a kan tsaunuka.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin wannan ruwayen su samar da ambaliyar ruwan sama mai tasowa da zubar burbushi a cikin hamada, da yankewar ƙasa a cikin yankunan tsaunuka.

rows.output: Harin Midsomer Norton: An kama mutane hudu da laifuka masu yawa
rows.reference: Harin Midsomer Norton:  Kame mutane huɗu da suka yi ƙoƙarin kisa

rows.output: An kama wasu yara maza uku da suka kai shekara 17 da namijin shekara 20 bisa zargin yunƙurin kisan kai bayan an gano wani yaro mai shekaru 16 da raunuka a Somerset.
rows.reference: An kame wasu yara su uku da wani mutum mai shekaru 20 a kan zargin ƙoƙarin yin kisa bayan an sami wani mai shekaru 16 da raunukan caka wuka a cikin Somerset.

rows.output: An gano yaro matashi mai rauni a yankin Excelsior Terrace na Midsomer Norton, a kusan 04:00 na safe a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An sami yaron ne da raunin a cikin yankin Farfajiyar Excelsior na Midsomer Norton, da kusan ƙarfe 04:00 BST na ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An kai shi asibitin inda yake cikin "yanayi mai kyau".
rows.reference: An ɗauke zuwa asibiti inda yake cikin wani yanayi “mai ƙarko.”

rows.output: An kama wani yaro mai shekaru 17, da wasu yara biyu masu shekaru 18, da namijin da ya kai shekaru 20 a cikin yankin Radstock, a cewar 'yan sanda na Avon da Somerset.
rows.reference: An kama wani mai shekaru 17, biyu masu shekaru 18 da wani mutum mai shekaru 20 da dare a cikin yankin Radstock, Avon inji ‘Yan Sandan Somerset.

rows.output: Jami'an sun yi kira ga duk wanda zai iya samun bidiyo na waya na abin da ya faru ya zo gaba.
rows.reference: Jami’ai sun roƙi duk wani wanda ƙila ke da ƙaramin bidiyo na wayar hannu na abin da ya faru da ya zo.

rows.output: Trump ya ce Kavanaugh ya sha wahala, rashin mutunci, fushi na jam'iyyar Democrat
rows.reference: Trump ya ce Kavanaugh ‘ya sha wahala, bakin hali, fushi’ na Jam’iyyar Democrat

rows.output: "Kuri'a ga Alkalin Kavanaugh ita ce kuri'a ta kin amincewa da tsauraran dabaru da kuma mugun halayen jam'iyyar Democrat," Trump ya ce a wani gangami a Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.reference: “Wata kuri’a don Alkali Kavanaugh kaɗa kuri’a ne don ƙin rashin tausayi da dabarun fin ƙarfi na Jam’iyyar Democrat,” inji Trump a wani gangami a cikin Wheeling, West Virginia.

rows.output: Trump ya ce Kavanaugh ya "jikkata, ya sha fushi" na jam'iyyar Democrat a duk lokacin da ake yi masa tsarin nada.
rows.reference: Trump ya ce Kavanaugh ya sha “wahalar rashin tausayi, fushi” na Jam’iyyar Democrat ta hanyar tura sunansa.

rows.output: Kavanaugh ya yi shaida a gaban Majalisar Dokoki a ranar Alhamis, yana mai cewa da karfi da tausayi cewa, wani zargi daga Christine Blasey Ford cewa ya yi mata fyade shekaru da dama da suka wuce lokacin da su biyu matasan ne.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh ya ba da shaida a gaban Congress a ranar Alhamis, da ƙarfi yana kuma cikin fushi na ƙin wani ƙage daga Christine Blasey Ford cewa ya far mata ta hanyar jima’i shekaru da yawa da suka wuce suna samari.

rows.output: Ford kuma ta yi shaida a zamanantar da ta yi game da zargin ta.
rows.reference: Ford ita ma ta ba shaida a jin bahasin game da ƙagen nata.

rows.output: Shugaban kasar ya ce a ranar Asabar cewa "amurkawa sun ga kyan gani da inganci da jarumta" na Kavanaugh a wannan ranar.
rows.reference: Shugaban ya faɗa a rana Asabar cewa “Amurkawa sun ga fasaha da kyau da ƙarfin hali” na Kavanaugh wannan ranar.

rows.output: "Wani kuri'a na tabbatar da Alkalin Kavanaugh shi ne kuri'a na tabbatar da daya daga cikin manyan tunanin shari'a na zamanmu, alkalin da ke da tarihin hidima ga jama'a mai kyau," ya gaya wa taron masu goyon bayan West Virginia.
rows.reference: “Wata kaɗa kuri’a don tabbatar da Alkali Kavanaugh West jefa kuri’a ne don tabbatar da ɗaya daga cikin masana shari’a da suka cimma rayuwa a wannan lokacin namu, wani masanin shari’a da ke da fitaccen rubutaccen labari na aikin jama’a,” ya faɗa a dandazon jama’a magoya baya na Virginia ta Yamma.

rows.output: Shugaban kasar ya yi nuni da ban mamaki game daar da aka yi wa Kavanaugh, yayin da yake magana kan muhimmancin fitar da jam'iyyar Republican a zabenaki na tsakiyar wa'adi.
rows.reference: Shugaban ya ɗan yi tsokaci ne game da tura sunan Kavanaugh a yayin da yake magana game da amfani na fitowar ‘yan Republican a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan tsakiyar zango.

rows.output: "Kwanaki biyar daga ɗaya daga cikin zaɓukan da suka fi muhimmanci a rayuwarmu.
rows.reference: “Saura makonni biyar zuwa ɗaya daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka mafi muhimmanci a lokutan rayuwarmu.

rows.output: Ba na gudu ba, amma ina ta gudu," ya ce.
rows.reference: Ba zan tsaya ba, amma a zahiri zan tsaya,” inji shi.

rows.output: "Abin da ya sa nake a ko'ina a kan fada don manyan 'yan takara."
rows.reference: “Shi ne ya sa nake ko’ina ina yaƙi don manyan ‘yan takara.”

rows.output: Trump ya ce 'yan Democrat suna da niyyar "juriya da toshewa."
rows.reference: Trump cikin mahawara ‘yan Democrat suna kan wata manufa ne ta “ƙi da taka burki.”

rows.output: An yi tsammanin za a yi wa farko a kan bene na majalisar dattijai kan zabe na Kavanaugh ba a da dadewa ba, a ranar Juma'a, wani jami'in shugaban jam'iyyar Republican ya gaya wa CNN.
rows.reference: Ana tsammanin farkon babban hanyar bi don kaɗa kuri’a a  daɗen Majalisar Dattawa a kan zaɓen Kavanaugh da za a yi da ba zai wuce Juma’a ba, a faɗar wani mai taimaka wa babban shugaba na GOP kamar yadda ya ce wa CNN.

rows.output: An kashe mutane da dama a cikin girgizar ƙasa ta Indonesia, tsunami, tare da yawan mace-mace na iya ƙaruwa
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwa sun mace a sakamakon girgizar ƙasar Indonesiya, kuma ganin ƙarin mutuwar

rows.output: Aƙalla mutane 384 ne suka mutu, da yawa aka yi wa su fushi yayin da manyan igiyoyin ruwa suka yi ta shiga bakin teku, lokacin da wani babban girgizar ƙasa da tsunami suka afku a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesia, a cewar hukumomi a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Aƙalla an kashe mutane 384, da tafiya da wasu saboda igiyoyin ruwa masu girma sun fado a kan bakin teku, a lokacin da wata babbar girgizar ƙasa da tsunami suka afka a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesiya, injin hukumomi a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi ta jira da mutane da dama a wani biki a bakin teku a birnin Palu a ranar Juma'a, lokacin da igiyoyin ruwa masu tsayi sama da mita shida (kafa 18) suka yi kaca-kaca a bakin teku a lokacin fadowa, inda suka kai ga mutuwar mutane da dama, tare da lalata duk wani abu da ke kan hanyar su.
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwan mutane suka taru don wani biki a kan teku na birnin Palu a ranar Juma’a a yayin da igiyoyin ruwan da suka mitoci shiɗa a sama (taku 18) suka afka bakin teku da dare, inda suka share da yawa suka mutu da lalata kowane abu da ke hanyar tasu.

rows.output: An yi ta'azzara bayan girgizar ƙasa mai girma 7.5.
rows.reference: Tsunamin ta biyo bayan wata girgizar ƙasa mai ƙarfin 7 da ɗigo 5.

rows.output: "Lokacin da aka samu barazana ta tsunami jiya, mutane har yanzu suna yin ayyukan su a bakin teku kuma ba su gudu nan take ba, kuma sun zama wanda ya mutu," in ji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar kare bala'i ta Indonesia BNPB a wani taro a Jakarta.
rows.reference: “A yayin da barazanar tsunamin ta taso jiya, mutane a lokacin suna ayyukansu ne a kan bakin tekun kuma ba su gudu nan da nan ba inda suka zama waɗanda abin ya shafa,” inji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar rage haɗura ta Indonesiya ta BNPB a cikin wata gajeruwar ganawa da ‘yan jarida a cikin Jakarta.

rows.output: "Harbin tsunami ba ya zuwa da kansa, ya ja motoci, katakon katako, gidajen, ya bugi komai a ƙasa," in ji Nugroho, yana kara cewa tsunami ya yi tafiya a cikin teku mai bude ido a kan gudun kilometa 800 a sa'a (497 mph) kafin ya bugi bakin teku.
rows.reference: “Tsunamin tazo da kanta ne, ta jawo ƙananan motoci, katakwaye, gidaje, ta kuma bugi duk abin da ke kan ƙasa,” inji Nugroho, inda ya kara da cewa tsunami ta yi tafiya a faɗin buɗeɗɗen teku da gudu na kilomita 800 kowace sa’a (mil 497 kowace sa’a) kafin ta sauka a bakin tekun.

rows.output: Wasu mutane sun haura bishiyoyi don su tsere daga ambaliya kuma suka tsira, ya ce.
rows.reference: Wasu mutanen sun hau bishiyoyi ne don tsira daga tsunami kuma sun rayu, inji shi.

rows.output: Kusan mutane 16,700 an kai su sansanonin 24 a Palu.
rows.reference: An kwashe kusan mutane 16,700 zuwa cibiyoyi 24 da ke cikin Palu.

rows.output: Hotunan da aka saki daga hukumar bala'i sun nuna da yawa daga cikin gine-gine da shaguna sun lalace, gada sun juya da kuma rugujewa, da kuma wani masjid da ke kewaye da ruwa.
rows.reference: Hotunan da aka ɗauka daga sama da hukumar haɗarin ta sake sun nuna gine-gine da shaguna a lalace, gadojin sun lankwashe da rushewa da wani masallaci ruwa ya kewaye shi.

rows.output: An ci gaba da girgizar ƙasa a birnin gabar teku a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An ci gaba da samun girgize-girgize na baya da suka addabi birnin da ke kusa da tekun a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi jerin girgizar ƙasa a yankin da ke da mutane miliyan 2.4.
rows.reference: An ji girgize-girgizen ƙasa a jere a wani yanki mai mutane miliyan 2 da dubu ɗari 4.

rows.output: Hukumar tantancewa da amfani da fasahar zamani ta Indonesia (BPPT) ta ce a wata sanarwa cewa, makamashin da aka saki a lokacin girgizar kasa mai girma a ranar Juma'a ya kai kusan sau 200 fiye da karfin bam din atomic da aka jefar a Hiroshima a lokacin yakin duniya na biyu.
rows.reference: Hukumar Auna da Aiwatar da Fasaha ta Indonesiya (BPPT) a cikin wata sanarwa ta ce ƙarfi da babbar girgizar ƙasa ta sake a ranar Jumu’ar ya kai kusan sau 200 na ƙarfin bam na sinadarin atom da aka jefa a kan Hiroshima a cikin Yakin Duniya na Biyu.

rows.output: Yankunan da ke kusa da birnin, wanda ke kusa da ƙarshen wani kunkuntar teku, na iya kara girma da girman tsunami, in ji.
rows.reference: Yanayi na birnin, wanda ke zaune a ƙarshe na wani ɗan ƙaramin ziri mai tsawo, ƙila shi ya faɗaɗa girma na tsunami ɗin, inji ta.

rows.output: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin "mai zurfi" kuma ya ce dubun-dubatar gidajen, asibitoci, shaguna, da otal-otal sun ruguje.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin “mai yawa” kuma ya ce dubun-dubata na gidaje, asibitoci, shagunan cinikayya da otel-otel duk sun ruguje.

rows.output: An gano gawoyin wasu wanda aka kashe a karkashin tarkacen ginin da ya ruguje, ya ce, ya kuma kara cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma 29 sun bace.
rows.reference: An sami gawarwakin waɗanda abin ya shafa a maƙale a ƙarƙashin gine-gine da suka rushe, inji shi, ya kuma ƙara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma an rasa 29.

rows.output: Nugroho ya ce, an samu asara da kuma lalacewa a gabar tekun, kimanin 300 km (190 mil) arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala, wanda ke kusa da cibiyar girgizar.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya ce yawan masu mutuwar da lalacewar zai ƙaru sosai a layin bakin teku kilomita 300 (mil 190) arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala,

rows.output: Hirar "ta yi gargaɗi sosai ba tare da wani bayani ba" daga Donggala, in ji Nugroho.
rows.reference: Sadarwa “gaba ɗaya sun tsaya cik kuma babu labari” daga Donggala, jinji Nugroho.

rows.output: Akwai fiye da mutane 300,000 da ke zaune a wurin, a cewar wata sanarwa daga cikin Red Cross, inda ta kara cewa ma'aikatan su da masu aikin sa kai suna kan hanyar zuwa wuraren da abin ya shafa.
rows.reference: Akwai fiye da mutane 300,000 da ke zauna a can,” inji ƙungiyar agaji ta Red Cross a cikin wata sanarwa, tana mai ƙarin cewa ma’aikatanta da masu sa-kai sun nufi yankunan da abin ya shafa.

rows.output: "Wannan ya rigaya ya zama bala'i, amma zai iya kara tsananta."
rows.reference: “Wannan tuni wani bala’i ne, amma zai iya ƙara muni,” inji ta.

rows.output: Hukumar ta fada a ranar Asabar da aka yi mata su ba da sanarwa cewa wani tsunami ya afku a Palu, duk da cewa jami'an sun ce igiyoyin ruwa sun iso cikin lokaci da aka fitar da gargadin.
rows.reference: An soki hukumar a ranar Asabar sosai don rashin sanarwa cewa wata tsunami za ta afka wa Palu, kodayake jami’ai sun ce igiyoyin ruwa sun zo a tsakanin lokacin da aka fitar da gargaɗin.

rows.output: A cikin wani faifan bidiyo na masu sha'awa da aka raba a shafukan sada zumunta, wani mutum a bene na sama na wani gini yana iya jin muryarsa tana yi wa mutane a kan titi a ƙasa.
rows.reference: Wani bidiyon da ba ƙwararre ba da aka raba ta kafar sada zumunta za a iya jin wani mutum a kan saman daɓe na wani gini yana ihun girgiza gargaɗi na kusantowar tsunami ga mutane da ke titin ƙasan.

rows.output: A cikin mintuna, katanga na ruwa ya yi ta kutsawa a bakin teku, yana ɗauke da gine-gine da motoci.
rows.reference: A cikin mintina wani bango na ruwa ya faɗo a kan tekun, yana ɗaukewa gine-gine da ƙananan motoci.

rows.output: An ba da damar duba bidiyo ba tare da izini ba.
rows.reference: Kamfanin dillacin labarai na Reuters ba iya tantance bidiyon ba nan da nan.

rows.output: Guguwar ta haifar da katsewar wutar lantarki mai girma da ta katse sadarwa a kusa da Palu, wanda ya sa ya yi wahala ga hukomomi su tsara aikin ceto.
rows.reference: Girgizar ƙasar da tsunamin sun haifar da katsewar lantarki da yanke sadarwa a kewayen Palu inda ya haifar da wahala ga hukumomi wajen haɗin gamayyar ƙoƙare-ƙoƙare na ceto.

rows.output: An fara aika jiragen ruwa masu kaya daga Jakarta da sauran birane, a cewar hukumomi, amma 'yan gudun hijira har yanzu suna buƙatar abinci da sauran abubuwan da ake buƙata.
rows.reference: Sojoji sun fara aika manyan jiragen ɗaukan kaya da tallafi daga Jakarta da sauran birane, inji hukumomi, amma waɗanda aka kwashen har yanzu suna sosai buƙatar abinci da sauran muhimman kayayyaki.

rows.output: An bude filin jirgin sama na birnin ne kawai don aikin agajin gaggawa kuma zai ci gaba da rufewa har zuwa Oktoba.
rows.reference: An sake buɗe filin jirgin sama na birnin kaɗai don ƙoƙare-ƙoƙaren kayan agaji kuma zai kasance a rufe sai har Octoba.

rows.output: Shugaba Joko Widodo ya yi shiri ya ziyarci cibiyoyin gaggawa a Palu a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: An tsara Shugaba Joko Widodo zai ziyarci cibiyoyin kwashewa mutane a cikin Palu a ranar Lahadi.

rows.output: Indoneshiya ta fuskanci ambaliya mai girma fiye da 800.
rows.reference: Ƙididdigar Mutuwar Tsunami a Indonesiya Ta Haura 800

rows.output: Yana da matuƙar muni.
rows.reference: Abin Ya Ɓaci Sosai.

rows.output: Yayin da ma'aikatan World Vision daga Donggala suka isa Palu cikin aminci, inda ma'aikatan ke kwanciya a cikin tarpaulin da aka kafa a cikin falo na ofishin su, sun ga abubuwan da suka lalata a hanya, in ji Mista Doseba.
rows.reference: Kodayake ma’aikatan World Vision sun koma birnin Palu lafiya ƙalau daga Donggala, inda ma’aikatan ke zaune a matsugunan tanfol da aka kafa a farfajiyar ofishin nasu, sun nuna wani hali na rugujewa a kan hanyar, inji Mista Doseba.

rows.output: "Sun gaya min sun ga gidaje da yawa da aka lalata," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Sun faɗa mun sun ga gidaje da yawa da suka rushe,” inji shi.

rows.output: Yana da matuƙar muni.
rows.reference: Abin ya ɓaci sosai.

rows.output: Koda yake, yayin da ƙungiyoyin agajin gaggawa suka fara aiki mai ban tausayi na fara aikin agajin gaggawa, wasu sun yi korafi cewa ma'aikatan agajin gaggawa na kasashen waje da ke da ƙwarewa sosai ana hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.
rows.reference: Duk da gungu-gungun ‘yan agaji da suka fara wata babbar hoɓɓasa ta fara aikin tallafi na bala’i, wasu sun yi ƙorafi cewa ma’aikatan agaji na waje da ke ƙwarewa sosai ana hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.

rows.output: Bisa ga dokokin Indonesia, kuɗaɗe, kayan aiki da ma'aikatan ƙasa da ƙasa za su iya fara gudana ne kawai idan an bayyana wurin bala'in a matsayin yankin bala'in ƙasa.
rows.reference: A cewar ƙa’idojin Indonesiya, kashe kuɗaɗe, samarwa da ba da ma’aikata daga ƙasashen waje kawai zai fara ne idan an furta wuri na fitina a matsayin zango na bala’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: "Da zarar gwamnatin ta ce, "Lafiya, wannan wata matsala ce ta kasa," za mu iya bude don taimakon kasa da kasa amma har yanzu babu wani matsayi."

rows.output: A lokacin da na biyu ya faɗo a Palu bayan girgizar ƙasa da ambaliya da ta afku a ranar Juma'a, abokai da 'yan uwa na waɗanda har yanzu ba a gano su ba suna jiran cewa masu ƙaunarsu za su kasance masu ceto da za su sa labarin rashin bege da ke da alaƙa da bala'o'i na halitta ya yi kyau.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda dare na biyu ya faɗa kan Palu bayan girgizar ƙasa da tsunami ta ranar Jumu’a, abokai da iyali na waɗanda suka ɓata suna ta fatan cewa ‘yan uwan nasu za su zama mu’ujizozi da za su rayar da layukan labari marar daɗi na bala’o’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: Gendon Subandono, kocin tawagar paragliding ta ƙasar Indonesia, ya horar da 'yan paragliding biyu da suka ɓace don gasar Asiya, wanda ya ƙare a farkon wannan watan a Indonesia.

rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari a ranar Asabar a Tlatelolco Plaza cewa "ba za a taba amfani da sojojin soji wajen tsoratar da mutanen Mexico ba."
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari ranar Asabar a Tlatelolco Plaza “kar a taɓa ko kaɗan amfani da sojoji wajen murƙushe mutanen Mexico.”

rows.output: An harbe mutane a lokacin da aka yi zanga-zanga a fadar a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda aka kashe mutane sama da 300 a lokacin da kuma a lokacin da motsin 'yan jarida na hagu ke kara karuwa a duk fadin Latin Amurka.

rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari zai tallafa wa matasa 'yan Mexico ta hanyar ba da tallafin wata-wata ga wadanda suke karatu da kuma bude karatun jami'o'in jama'a masu kyau.
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari na goyon bayan samari ‘yan Mexico ta ba da tallafe-tallafe na wata-wata ga waɗanda ke karatu kuma da buɗe ƙarin jami’o’i na gwamnati kyauta.

rows.output: Ya ce rashin aikin yi da kuma rashin damar ilimi yana jawo matasa zuwa ƙungiyoyin masu laifi.
rows.reference: Ya kuma ce rashin aikin yi da wani rashi na damammakin ilmi su ne ke jan samari zuwa gungun ƙungiyoyi masu aikata laifi.

rows.output: Ya kamata Amurka ta ninka kuɗin da take kashewa a fannin A.I.
rows.reference: Ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya kuɗin A.I.

rows.output: Yayin da Sin ke kara shiga cikin fasahar basira, ya kamata Amurka ta ninka adadin kudi da take kashewa a fannin bincike, in ji mai zuba jari da mai amfani da AI, Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki a Google, Microsoft da Apple.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda China ta zama tana aiki sosai a cikin hikimar da ba ta asali ba, ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya yawan abin da take kashewa a cikin nazari da ke cikin filin, inji mai zuba jari mai gwada hikimar da ba ta asalin ba Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki da Google, Microsoft da Apple.

rows.output: An yi sharhi ne bayan da sassa daban-daban na gwamnatin Amurka suka yi sanar da AI, duk da cewa Amurka gaba ɗaya ba ta da wani tsari na hukuma na AI.
rows.reference: Sharhohin suna zuwa ne bayan ɓangarori da dama na gwamnatin Amurka sun yi furuci a kan AI na hikimar da ba ta asalin ba, duk da cewa Amurka ta rasa wata dabarar AI a  tsare.

rows.output: A halin yanzu, Sin ta gabatar da shirinta na shekara ta 2030: tana da niyyar zama No.1 a fannin ƙirkire-ƙirkire na AI.
rows.reference: A halin da ake cikin, China ta gabatar da shirinta shekarar da ta wuce: tana ƙoƙarin ta zama ta farko a cikin ƙago AI a shekara ta 2030.

rows.output: "Ƙara kasafin kuɗin bincike na AI sau biyu zai zama kyakkyawan fara'a, idan aka yi la'akari da cewa dukkan ƙasashen da ke baya da Amurka, kuma muna neman ci gaban AI na gaba." in ji Lee.
rows.reference: “Ruɓanya kasafin kuɗi na AI zai zama wani mafari mai kyau, ganin cewa dukkan sauran ƙasashe sun yi gaba sosai a bayan Amurka kuma muna neman wani sabon abu a cikin AI,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Kasadar samun nasarar fasaha ta farko a Amurka za ta iya ninka sau biyu idan an ninka kudaden da ake bayarwa, in ji Lee a wani hirar da ya yi da CNBC a wannan makon.
rows.reference: Ruɓanya kashe kuɗi zai iya rubanya damammaki inda za a cimma babban AI na gaba a cikin Amurka, Lee ya ce wa CNBC a cikin wata intabiyu wannan makon.

rows.output: To, wanda littafin "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" ya buga a wannan watan ta Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, shi ne shugaban kamfanin Sinovation Ventures, wanda ya zuba jari a daya daga cikin manyan kamfanonin AI a China, Face++.
rows.reference: Lee, wanda Houghton Mifflin Harcourt ya buga littafinsa "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order"  wannan watan, shi ne Babban Shugaba na Sinovation Ventures China, wanda ya zuba jari a cikin daya daga sanannun kamfanonin AI a cikin China, Face++.

rows.output: A cikin shekarun 1980 a Jami'ar Carnegie Mellon, ya yi aiki a kan tsarin AI wanda ya doke mafi kyawun dan wasan Othello na Amurka, kuma daga baya ya zama jami'in bincike a Microsoft kuma shugaban reshen Google na kasar Sin.
rows.reference: A cikin shekaru na 1980 a Jami’ar Carnegie Mellon ya yi aiki a kan wani tsarin AI da ya doke ɗan wasan Amurka Othello da ya fi matsayi, daga baya kuma ya zama wani zababben shugaba a Microsoft Research da shugaban Google na reshen China.

rows.output: Lee ta amince da gasar fasaha ta gwamnati ta Amurka a baya kamar gasar Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge kuma ta tambaya lokacin da na gaba zai kasance, don taimakawa wajen gano masu hangen nesa na gaba.
rows.reference: Lee ya faɗi gasa ta baya ta gwamnatin Amurka a kan fasaha kamar Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge inda ya tambaya yaushe ne za a yi na gaban, saboda ya taimaka gane masu hange nesa na gaba.

rows.output: Masu bincike a Amurka sau da yawa suna aiki tuƙuru don samun tallafin gwamnati, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Manazarta a cikin Amurka yawanci sukan yi aiki tuƙuru saboda cin taimakon kuɗaɗen gwamnati, inji Lee.

rows.output: "Ba kasar Sin da ke ɗaukar masu koyar da ilimi ba; kamfanoni ne." Lee ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ba China ne ke ɗaukewa shugabannin ilmi ba; kamfanoni ne,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanoni na fasaha sun dau manyan masana kimiyya daga jami'o'i don yin aiki kan AI a cikin shekaru masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanonin fasaha sun ɗauki hayar manyan masu ilmi daga jami’o’i don aiki a kan AI a shekarun kwana nan.

rows.output: Lee ya ce canje-canje a manufofin shige da fice za su iya taimakawa Amurka wajen ƙara karfinta a fannin AI.
rows.reference: Lee ya ce canje-canjen ƙudurin shiga ƙasa zai iya kuma taimakon Amurka ta daga ƙoƙare-ƙoƙarenta na AI.

rows.output: Ina ganin katunan kore su kasance a yi musu aiki ta atomatik ga waɗanda suka kammala PhD a fannin AI," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ina jin ya kamata korayen katina su zama kai-tsaye ake samar da su ga masu digirin-digirgir a fannin hikimar AI da ba ta asali ba,” inji shi.

rows.output: Hukumar Jiha ta China ta fitar da tsarin ci gaban fasahar basirar AI ta gaba a watan Yuli 2017.
rows.reference: Majalisar Ƙasar China ta fitar da Shirin Ci Gaban Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Don Al’ummar Gaba nata a cikin Yulin 2017.

rows.output: Asusun Kimiyyan Halitta ta Kasa ta China tana samar da kuɗin ga mutanen da ke cikin jami'o'i kamar yadda Asusun Kimiyyan Halitta da sauran ƙungiyoyin gwamnati ke yi wa masu bincike a Amurka, amma ingancin aikin ilimi ya yi ƙasa a China, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Gidauniyar Kimiyya na Halitta ta Ƙasa ta China ta samar da kuɗaɗe ga mutane a makarantun ilmi irin zuwa ga hanyar da Gidauniyar Kimiyyar ta Ƙasa da sauran hukumomin gwamnati ke ba da kuɗi ga manazartan Amurka, amma yanayin darajar aikin ilmi ya yi ƙasa a cikin China, inji Lee.

rows.output: A farkon wannan shekara, Ma'aikatar Tsaro ta Amurka ta kafa cibiyar Haɗin Gwiwar Hasken Gaskiya, da nufin ta haɗa kai da abokai daga masana'antu da jami'o'i, kuma fadar White House ta sanar da kafa kwamitin da aka zaba kan Hasken Gaskiya.

rows.output: Kuma wannan watan, DARPA ta sanar da zuba jarin dala biliyan 2 a wani shiri mai suna AI Na Gaba.

rows.output: Game da NSF, a halin yanzu tana saka hannun jari fiye da dala miliyan 100 a duk shekara a cikin bincike na AI.

rows.output: A halin yanzu, dokokin Amurka da ke neman ƙirƙirar Hukumar Tsaro ta Kasa kan Harsashi na Wucin Gadi ba a ga an yi wani abu a cikin watanni ba.

rows.reference: Mutanen Macedonia sun jefa kuri’a a cikin wata raba gardama a ranar Lahadi ko ta canza sunanta zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Arewacin Macedonia,” a wani yinƙuri da zai warware wata tsohuwar taƙaddama tare da Greece wadda ta toshe nemanta na zama mamba don Tarayyar Turai da NATO.

rows.output: Girka, wadda ke da lardin da ake kira Masedoniya, tana mai cewa sunan makwabcinta na arewa yana wakiltar da'awarta kan ƙasa, kuma ta hana shiga NATO da EU.

rows.output: Gwabobin gwamnati biyu sun cim ma yarjejeniyar a watan Yuni bisa sunan da aka ba da shawarar, amma masu adawa da ra'ayin ƙasar sun ce canjin zai raunana asalin al'adun ƙasar na mutanen Slavic na Macedonia.
rows.reference: Gwamnatin biyu sun sami wata matsayi a Yuni a bisa wani sabon suna da suka ƙudurta, amma masu adawa na ‘yan kasanci sun yi mahawara canjin zai rage shaidar ƙabilanci na jama’a ‘yan Slav da suka yawa na Macedonia.

rows.output: Shugaba Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai yi zabe ba a zaben da aka yi, kuma yunƙurin da aka yi na hana zama a cikin zabe ya sa aka yi shakku ko za a iya cim ma kaso 50 cikin 100 da ake buƙata don a yi zaben.
rows.reference: Shugaba Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai yi zaɓe a cikin raba gardamar ba kuma wani kamfe na ƙauracewa ya sa shakku a kan ko yawan fitowar zai isa matsaikacin kashi 50 cikin ɗari da ake buƙata don raba gardamar ta inganta.

rows.output: Tambayar a kan katin zaɓe ta karanta: "Kana goyon bayan shiga NATO da EU tare da karɓar yarjejeniyar da Girka ta amince da ita."
rows.reference: Tambayar da ke kan kuri’ar raba gardamar tana cewa: “Kai na NATO da zama mamban Tarayyar Turai ne da yarda da yarjejeniyar tare da Greece.”

rows.output: Masu goyon bayan canjin sunan, ciki har da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun ce hakan farashi ne mai kyau don neman shiga cikin kungiyoyi kamar EU da NATO ga Masedoniya, daya daga cikin kasashe da suka fito daga rushewar Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Masu goyon bayan canza sunan, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun yi mahawara cewa wata sadaukarwa ce don bin shiga cikin hukumomin kamar su Tarayyar Turai da NATO don Macedonia, ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe da suka bayyana daga rushewa ta Yugoslavia.

rows.output: Na zo yau ne domin kada kuri'a ga makomar kasar, ga matasa a Masedoniya don su iya rayuwa cikin 'yanci a karkashin inuwar Tarayyar Turai saboda yana nufin rayuwa mai aminci ga dukkanmu," in ji Olivera Georgijevska, mai shekaru 79, a Skopje.
rows.reference: “Na zo nan yau don jefa kuri’a don makoma ta ƙasar, don mutane samari a cikin Macedonia saboda za su iya rayuwa da ‘yanci a ƙarƙashin lema ta Tarayyar Turai saboda yana nufin rayuwa mai tsaro a gare mu,” inji Olivera Georgijevska, mai shekaru 79, a cikin Skopje.

rows.output: Duk da ba aatar da doka ba, da yawa daga cikin mambobin majalisar dokokin sun bayyana cewa za su bi sakamakon kuri'ar, wanda hakan ya sa ta zama mai tasiri.
rows.reference: Kodayake ba ya da ƙarfi na shari’a, isassun mambobi na majalisar dokoki sun ce za su bi sakamako na jefa kuri’ar don ta zama ta daidaita.

rows.output: Sake sunan zai bukaci kaso biyu bisa uku na kuri'u a majalisar dokoki.
rows.reference: Canza sunan zai buƙaci wan yawa na kashi biyu bisa uku na majalisar dokokin.

rows.output: Hukumar zaɓe ta jihar ta ce ba a samu rahoto na rashin daidaiton zabe ba da misalin karfe 1 na rana.
rows.reference: Hukumar zaɓe ta ƙasar ta ce babu rahotanni na matsaloli har zuwa ƙarfe 1 na rana.

rows.output: Duk da haka, fitowar masu jefa kuri'a ta kai kashi 16%, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 34% a zaben majalisar dattijai na 2016 lokacin da kashi 66% na masu rajista suka jefa kuri'arsu.
rows.reference: Amma, fitowar ta tsaya kawai a kashi 15 cikin ɗari, idan an kwatanta da kashi 34 a cikin ɗari a zaɓen majalisar dokoki na 2016 a yayin da kashi 66 cikin ɗari na masu jefa kuri’a da ke rijista suka kaɗa kuri’arsu.

rows.output: Na fito na kada kuri'a saboda 'ya'yana, wurinmu a Turai ne," in ji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wanda ya yi kuri'a a babban birnin, Skopje.
rows.reference: “Na fito ne don jefa kuri’a saboda ‘ya’yana, matsayinmu yana cikin Turai ne,” inji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wani mai jefa kuri’a cikin babban birnin, Skopje.

rows.output: Ndị AM Welsh na-echegbu onwe ha banyere "ịdị ka muppets"
rows.reference: Welsh AM na enwe mgbakasị ahụ maka ‘ị dị ka ihe egwuregwu’

rows.output: Enwere nchegbu n'etiti ụfọdụ ndị AMs maka aro na aha ha ga-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Onye otu nzuko Welsh).
rows.reference: Enwere nchekasị ahụ n’ime ụfọdụ AMs maka ntụle na ekwesịrị ịgbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).

rows.output: Ọ pụtaworo n'ihi atụmatụ ịgbanwe aha nke ọgbakọ ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Ụlọ Nzukọ Welsh.
rows.reference: Ọ malitere n’ihi atụmatụ nke ịgbanwe aha nke ndị otu obodo ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Nzụkọ Omeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: Ndị AMs n'ofe usoro ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-echegbu onwe ha na ọ nwere ike ịkpọasị ha.
rows.reference: AMs n’ofe ụdị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị dị iche iche na enwe nchekasị ahụ na ọ nwere ike ibute ihe mkparị.

rows.output: Otu ndị ọrụ Labour kwuru na otu ya nwere nchegbu "na ọ na-eme ka Twp na Pwp."
rows.reference: Otu AM nke Labour kwuru na ndị otu ya na echekasị na “ọ na ada ka Twp na Pwp.”

rows.output: Maka ndị na-agụ akwụkwọ n'èzí Wales: N'ụzọ Welsh, twp pụtara onye ara ara na pwp pụtara ihe mkpori.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ọgụ akwụkwọ nọ na mpụga Wales: Na Welsh twp pụtara iberibe, pwp pụtara nsị.

rows.output: Otu Plaid AM kwuru na otu ahụ n'ozuzu ya "adịghị enwe obi ụtọ" ma tụọ aro ihe ndị ọzọ.
rows.reference: AM Yi Uwe Ajị Anụ kwuru na otu ahụ dị ka dum “na ewe iwe”, na ọ nwere ihe ndị ọzọ atụnyere.

rows.output: Onye Conservative Welsh kwuru na �tù ya "na-emeghe uche" banyere mgbanwe aha ahụ, ma kwupụta na ọ bụ obere ịwụpụ site na MWP gaa na Muppet.
rows.reference: Otu onye Kọnzavetiv Welsh kwuru na otu ya “meghere obi emeghe” gbasara mgbanwe aha ahụ, mana kwupụta na ọ bụ mkpumkpu nwụfe okwu site na MWP gaa na Ihe Egwuregwu.

rows.output: N'okwu a, mkpụrụedemede Welsh w na-ekwu okwu dị ka otu Yorkshire English na-ekwu okwu.
rows.reference: Na nghọta a ana akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede w nke Welsh otu ụzọ ka esi akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede u nke Bekee nke Yorkshire.

rows.output: Kọmiti Nzukọ, nke na-edegharị iwu ugbu a iji webata mgbanwe aha, kwuru: "Mkpebi ikpeazụ maka ihe ọ bụla na-akọwa ihe ndị otu Assembly na-akpọ ga-adị n'aka ndị otu n'onwe ha."
rows.reference: Kọmishọn nke Mgbakọ Mba ahụ, nke na edepụta iwu iji bubata mgbanwe aha ahụ, kwuru: “Mkpebi ikpeazụ na ihe nkọwa ọ bụla nke a na akpọ Ndị Otu nke Mgbakọ Mba ga-abụ okwu maka ndị otu n’onwe ha.”

rows.output: Iwu gọọmentị nke Wales 2017 nyere ndị Welsh Assembly ikike ịgbanwe aha ya.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị nke Atụmatụ Wales 2017 nyere mgbakọ mba Welsh ikike iji gbanwee aha ya.

rows.output: N'ọnwa Jun, Kọmishọna ahụ wepụtara nsonaazụ nyocha ọha na eze banyere atụmatụ ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado sara mbara maka ịkpọ ọgbakọ ahụ Welsh Parliament.
rows.reference: Na Juun, Kọmịshọn ahụ bipụtara nsonaazụ nke ndụmọdụ ọhaneze na ebumnuche ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado gbasara agbasa maka ịkpọ mgbakọ mba ahụ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: N'ihe gbasara aha AMs, kọmishọna ahụ tụgharịrị ndị otu Welsh Parliament ma ọ bụ WMPs, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kachasị n'ime nyocha ọha.
rows.reference: N’okwu nke aha nke ndị AM, Kọmịshọn ahụ dabedoro na Ndị Otu Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh ma ọ bụ WMP, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kachasị n’aka ndụmọdụ nke ọhaneze.

rows.output: Ndị AMs na-ekwu na ha na-atụ aro nhọrọ ndị ọzọ, mana a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-abụ ihe isi ike irute nkwenye ga-eme ka onye isi oche, Elin Jones, bụ onye a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ezipụta iwu ndị a na-eme n'ime izu ole na ole.
rows.reference: Ndị AM na atụnye nhọrọ ndị ọzọ n’ezie, mana ọgụ iji ruo nkwekọrịta nwere ike ịbụ ihe isi mgbu maka Onye Ọrụ Nọ N’isi, Elin Jones, onye nke atụrụ anya na ọ ga-enyefe iwu edere edere maka mgbanwe ndị ahụ n’ime izu ndị na abịa.

rows.output: Iwu gbasara mgbanwe ahụ ga-agụnyekwa mgbanwe ndị ọzọ na otu ndị omebe iwu si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere iwu gbasara ịkagbu ndị otu na nhazi usoro kọmiti.
rows.reference: Iwu maka mmezi ndị ahụ ga-agụnye mgbanwe ndị ọzọ n’ụzọ nke mgbakọ mba ahụ si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere iwu maka nchutu nke ndị AM yana nka nke sistemụ otu ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị AM ga-enwe ikike ikpeazụ ịtule ajụjụ nke ihe ha kwesịrị ịkpọ mgbe ha na-eme mkpebi iwu ahụ.
rows.reference: Ndị AM ga-enwete ntuli aka ikpeazụ gbasara ajụjụ nke ihe ekwesịrị ịkpọ ha mgbe ha arụtụrụ aka gbasara iwu ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị Macedonia na-aga n'ụlọ ntụli aka n'ụdị nhọpụta nke ịgbanwe aha obodo ahụ
rows.reference: Ndị Macedonia ga-aga ntuli aka maka nhọpụta nke ịgbanwe aha obodo ha

rows.output: Ndị na-eme ntụli aka ga-eme ntụli aka na Sọnde ma ọ bụ gbanwee aha obodo ha ka ọ bụrụ "Republic of North Macedonia."
rows.reference: Ndị ntuli aka ga-atuli aka na Sọnde ma a ga-agbanwe aha obodo ha ka ọ bụrụ “Repọbliki nke North Macedonia.”

rows.output: Vootu a na-ewu ewu ka e mee iji dozie esemokwu ogologo oge na mba ndị dị nso, bụ́ Grik, nke nwere ógbè nke a na-akpọ Macedonia.
rows.reference: Atọlitere ntuli aka nke igwe mmadụ iji kpezie esemokwu ogologo oge dị n’etiti ndị agbataobi bụ Greece, nke nwere mpaghara nke ya akpọrọ Macedonia.

rows.output: Atensị enwetala ogologo oge na-ekwu na aha onye agbata obi ya n'ebe ugwu na-anọchi anya ihe na-ekwu na ha nwere ala ya, ma na-emegide mbọ ya ịbata na EU na NATO.
rows.reference: Oteela Athens kwubere na aha nke ndị agbataobi ya nọ n’ugwu na egosipụta nzọrọ na mpaghara ya, ha agaala n’ihu na egbochi arịrịọ nsonye ya maka EU na NATO.

rows.output: Onye isi ala Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, onye na-emegide ntụli aka gbasara mgbanwe aha, ekwupụtala na ya agaghị anabata nhọpụta ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Gjorge Ivanov nke Macedonia, onye iro nke ntuli aka na mgbanwe aha ahụ, ekwuola na ọ ga-eleghara ntuli aka ahụ anya.

rows.output: N'agbanyeghị, ndị na-akwado ntuli aka ahụ, gụnyere Onye isi ala Zoran Zaev, na-ekwu na mgbanwe aha bụ naanị ihe a ga-akwụ ụgwọ iji sonye na EU na NATO.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, ndị nkwado nke nhọpụta ahụ, gụnyere Praịm Minista Zoran Zaev, na arụrụ aka na mgbanwe aha ahụ bụ naanị ụgwọ a ga-akwụ iji sonye na EU na NATO.

rows.reference: “Ụlọ mmanya abụghịzị ime ụlọ nke gburugburu ebe ndị mmadụ na-aga kwa oge.”

rows.output: N'ihe gbasara ụlọ ụka, ọ na-echegbu onwe ya na ego sitere n'ịre ihe onwunwe agaghị adịru ogologo oge ka ndị isi na-atụ anya ya, "ma n'oge na-adịghị anya, ha ga-alọta ebe ha si."
rows.reference: Maka ndị ụlọ ụka, ọ na echekasị na ego enwetere na ịre akụ agaghị anọte aka otu ndị isi si chee, “ma n’oge adịghị anya ma ọ bụ emechaa ha ga-alaghachite ebe ha bidoro.”

rows.output: Ụlọ ụka, o kwuru, nwere ike dochie ya site n'ụlọ elu ụlọ ebe a na-ahụ maka ụlọ ndị nwere ụlọ obibi nwere ndị ga-aghọ ndị na-adịghị enyere aka n'ebe ndị nsọ fọdụrụ n’obodo ahụ nọ.

rows.output: "Ọtụtụ ndị na-azụ ụlọ n'ụlọ ndị a ga-abụ ndị ọcha," ka o kwuru, "na ha ga-eme ka ụlọ ụka ndị a mechie n'ụzọ zuru ezu n'ihi na ọ gaghị adị ka ọtụtụ ndị a na-eme ka ha bie n'ụlọ ndị a ga-abụ ndị otu ụka ndị a."
rows.reference: “Nnukwu imirikiti ndị mmadụ na azụta nkewa ụlọ n’ụlọ ndị a ga-abụ ndị ọcha, “o kwuru, “ya mere ha ga-eme ka ụbọchị nke ndị ụlọ ụka a ga-emechi kpamkpam bịa ngwangwa n’ihi ọ ga-esi ike imirikiti ndị mmadụ na akwabata n’ime ụlọ ndị a bụrụ ndị otu nke ụlọ ụka ndị a.”

rows.reference: Rev. David Johnson, nwa Fada Johnson yana onye nọchiri na St. Martin, ji obi aṅụrị kpọọ igwe mgbịrịmgba ahụ “mgbịrịmgba nke ndị ogbenye.”

rows.output: Onye ọrụ ahụ nke mere ka ọkpọkọtọ ahụ na Julaị kpọrụ ya ihe ọzọ: "ihe nketa omenala" na "ngwá ọrụ akụkọ ihe mere eme na-adịghị dochie anya."

rows.reference: Ọkachamara ahụ, Tiffany Ng nke Mahadum nke Michigan, kwukwara na ọ bụ igwe mgbịrịmgba izizi dị n’ụwa nke onye egwu isi ojii ga-akpọ, Dionisio A. Lind, onye nke gara n’igwe mgbịrịmgba ka ibu dị na Ụlọ Ụka Riverside afọ 18 gara aga.

rows.output: Mazi Merriweather kwuru na St. Martin's emeghị ka ọ dochie ya.

rows.output: Ihe mere n'ụlọ ụka St. Martin n’ime ọnwa ole na ole gara aga bụ akụkọ mgbagwoju anya nke ndị na-ese ụlọ na ndị na-arụ ọrụ, ụfọdụ ndị e wetara n’aka ndị isi ụlọ ụka, ndị ọzọ n’aka diocese Anglican.

rows.output: Ụlọ ụka - ụlọ ọchịchị obodo ahụ, nke e ji ndị isi obodo mejupụta - dere bishọp n'ọnwa Julaị na nchegbu na bishọp "ga-achọ ịgafe ụgwọ" n'ụlọ ụka, n'agbanyeghị na ụlọ ụka ahụ etinyeghị aka n'ịhọpụta ndị na-ese ụlọ na ndị na-arụ ọrụ bishọp zigara.

rows.reference: Dị ka amụma ihuigwe, Oke Ifufe Rosa na ada ka ọ agafe n’elu mmiri juru oyi nke akụkụ osimiri n’ebe ugwu nke Mexico.

rows.output: Ọbụna, Rosa ga-ebute oke mmiri ozuzo n'ofe ugwu Mexico na ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ U.S. n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole na-abịa.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, Rosa ga-ebute mmiri ozizo ga-ebute ide mmiri n’ofe ebe ugwu nke Mexico yana akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda nke U.S. n’ụbọchị ndị na abia.

rows.output: Rosa nwere ikuku nke 85 mph, nke bụ Hurricane 1, n'oge 5 n'ụtụ ụtụtụ Sọnde, ma ọ dị na 385 kilomita ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ nke Punta Eugenia, Mexico.
rows.reference: Rosa nwere ikuku 85 mph, Oke Ifufe nke Otu 1, ebe 5 ụtụtụ. Oge ọwụwa anyanwụ Sọnde, ọ dị na maịlụ 385 nke ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda nke Punta Eugenia, Mexico.

rows.output: Rosa na-atụ anya na ọ ga-aga n'ebe ugwu na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Atụrụ anya na Rosa ga-aga n’ebe ugwu na Sọnde.

rows.output: N'otu oge ahụ, oke mmiri na-amalite ịmịpụta n'elu Oké Osimiri Pasifik ma na-aga n'ebe ọwụwa anyanwụ n'akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ nke U.S. Ka Rosa na-eru n'akụkụ Baja California n'ụbọchị Mọnde dị ka oké ifufe, ọ ga-amalite ịkwaga n'ebe ugwu nke ukwuu nke mmiri okpomoku n'ime ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ U.S.
rows.reference: Ugbu a, nnukwu oghere ebidola ịchịkọta n’ofe Oke Osimiri Pacific ma gaa ọwụwa anyanwụ na-aga Akụkụ Osimiri Ọdịda Anyanwụ nke U.S. Ka Rosa na erute ala mmiri Baja California na Mọnde ka oke ikuku mmiri, ọ ga-ebido ịkwa oke mmiri miri emi gaa n’ebe ugwu n’ime nke ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda nke U.S.

rows.output: Rosa ga-ewetara ihe ruru sentimita iri n'ụfọdụ akụkụ Mexico n'ụbọchị Mọnde.
rows.reference: Rosa ga-ebulite mmiri ozizo toruru 10 inchis n’akụkụ nke Mexico na Mọnde.

rows.output: Mgbe ahụ, mmiri mmiri okpomoku na-emekọrịta ihe na iberibe na-abịa ga-eme ka mmiri ozuzo dị arọ gbasaa n'ofe ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ n'ime ụbọchị ndị na-abịa.
rows.reference: Mgbe ahụ, oke mmiri na agwakọta n’ime nnukwu oghere na abịa ga-emepụta nnukwu mmiri ozizo gbasara agbasa n’ebe Ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda n’ofe ụbọchị ndị na abịa.

rows.output: N'ụzọ dị otu a, mmiri ozuzo 1 ruo 4 inch ga-eme ka idei mmiri na-efe efe dị ize ndụ, mmiri na-asọpụta na ihe ndị nwere ike ịdapụ n'ugwu n'ọzara.
rows.reference: Na mpaghara, mmiri ozizo ruru 1 ruo 4 inchis ga-ebute ide mmiri jọrọ njọ, ọsụsọ ahịhịa yana ala ọzịze nwere ike ịdị n’ọzara.

rows.output: Mmiri mmiri na-emetọ nke ukwuu ga-eme ka ọnụ ọgụgụ mmiri ozuzo dị n'etiti sentimita 2 na 3 kwa elekere n'ebe ụfọdụ, karịsịa n'akụkụ ndịda Nevada na Arizona.
rows.reference: Oke mmiri miri emi ga-ebute oke mmiri ozizo irute inchi 2 ruo 3 kwa aka elekere na nkebi, karịchara n’akụkụ nke ndịda Nevada na Arizona.

rows.output: Ihe ruru sentimita 2 ruo 4 nke mmiri ozuzo nwere ike ime n'akụkụ ụfọdụ nke ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ, karịsịa n'elu nnukwu akụkụ nke Arizona.
rows.reference: Dị ka a na atụ anya inchis 2 ruo 4 nke mmiri ozizo n’ụfọdụ akụkụ nke Ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda, karịchaa n’ofe nke Arizona.

rows.output: Mgbapụta nke ukwuu nwere ike ime n'ihi ọnọdụ na-adịghị mma na-eme ngwa ngwa n'ihi ụdị mmiri ozuzo nke mmiri ozuzo.

rows.output: Ọ ga-abụ ihe na-adịghị mma ịbata n'ime ọhịa n'ụkwụ n'ihi ihe egwu nke mmiri ozuzo okpomoku.
rows.reference: Ọ ga-abụ nnukwu ndụmọdụ jọrọ njọ iji ụkwụ gara banye n’ọzara ebe enwere ihe egwu nke oke mmiri ozizo.

rows.output: Oyiri mmiri nwere ike ime ka ugwu ghọọ osimiri na-awagharị, oké ifufe ga-eweta ikuku na-awagharị na uzuzu na-efe.
rows.reference: Nnukwu mmiri ozizo nwere ike ịme ka kanyọns bụrụ osimiri ji iwe yana egbe eluigwe na amụma ga-ebute oke ifufe na aja na efesasị efe.

rows.output: Mmiri ozuzo nke karịrila inch iri na abụọ nwere ike ime, nke nwere ike ibute obere ihe ndị na-eme ka ọ dị nro n'okporo ụzọ.

rows.reference: Ụfọdụ nyọsa oke mmiri ozizo fesara efesa ga-ebido irute Arizona na mgbede Sọnde yana n’isi ụtụtụ Mọnde, tupu mmiri ozizo ahụ agbasasịa na mgbede Mọnde na Tusde.

rows.output: Ọktoba nwere ike ịhụ mgbanwe dị ukwuu n'okpomoku n'ofe U.S. ka Arctic na-ajụ oyi, ma tropics na-anọgide na-ekpo ọkụ.
rows.reference: Ọktọba nwere ike ịhụ ụfọdụ mgbanwe temprechọ dị ike n’ofe U.S. ka Arctic na ejuwanye oyi, mana ebe okpomọkụ ga-enwe okpomọkụ.

rows.output: Ọ na-ebute mgbe ụfọdụ nnukwu mgbanwe na okpomọkụ n'ime obere anya.

rows.reference: Enwere nnukwu ịmaatụ nke ndịiche temprechọ dị egwu gafere n’etiti U.S. na Satọde.

rows.output: Enwere ihe dị ka 20 degrees Celsius dị iche n'etiti Kansas City, Missouri, na Omaha, Nebraska, na n'etiti St. Louis na Des Moines, Iowa.
rows.reference: Enwere ihe rutere ndịiche temprechọ digrii-20 n’etiti Kansas City, Missouri, na Omaha, Nebraska, yana n’etiti St. Louis na Des Moined, Iowa.

rows.output: N'ime ụbọchị ole na ole sochirinụ, okpomọkụ nke okpomoku ga-agbalị ịrụpụta na ịgbasa ọzọ.

rows.output: Ọtụtụ n'ime etiti na ọwụwa anyanwụ U.S. na-atụ anya na ọ ga-amalite n'October na okpomọkụ na-emetụta 80s site na Southern Plains ruo n'akụkụ nke Northeast.
rows.reference: Atụrụ anya na imirikiti n’ebe etiti na ọwụwa anyanwụ U.S. ga-ahụ mbido Ọktọba nwere ekpomọkụ gbasara 80s bido na Ala Ndịda ruo n’akụkụ nke Ọwụwa anyanwụ na ugwu.

rows.output: Obodo New York nwere ike irute ogo 80 na Tuzdee, nke ga-abụ ihe dị ka ogo 10 n'elu nkezi.
rows.reference: New York City nwere ike iru digrii 80 na Tusde, nke ga-abụ ihe dị ka digrii 10 karịa nkezi.

rows.output: Ihe ngosi ihu igwe anyị na-egosi na enwere nnukwu ohere maka okpomọkụ dị elu maka ọwụwa anyanwụ U.S. n'ime ọkara mbụ nke Ọktoba.

rows.output: Ihe karịrị nde iri abụọ na nde mmadụ hụrụ Brett Kavanaugh n'ụlọ ikpe.

rows.output: Ihe karịrị nde iri abụọ na nde mmadụ hụrụ nkwupụta na-ekwu okwu na Thursday site n'aka onye a họpụtara maka Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu, Brett Kavanaugh, na nwanyị ahụ na-ebo ebubo na ọ na-eme ihe ike mmekọahụ na ya n'afọ 1980, Christine Blasey Ford, na netwọkọ telivishọn isii.
rows.reference: Ihe karịrị ọnụọgụ ndị mmadụ nde 20 lelere nkwupụta akaebe nke Tọsde sitere n’aka Brett Kavanaugh onye ahọpụtara maka Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị yana nwanyị boro ya ebubo nke mwakpo n’ike mere na 1980, Christine Blasey Ford, na netwọk igwe onyonyoo isi.

rows.output: N'otu oge ahụ, ọgbaghara ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị gara n'ihu, ebe ndị na-ebufe ozi na-akpaghasị mmemme kwa ụbọchị maka ntụgharị ikpeazụ nke Fraịde: nkwekọrịta nke onye omebe iwu Arizona bụ Jeff Flake mere ka ndị FBI mee nyocha otu izu banyere ebubo ahụ.
rows.reference: Ugbu a, nkwụsịdo ike ndọrọndọrọ ahụ gara n’ihu, ndị mgbasa ozi nọ na akwụsịbido mmemme ndị kwesịrị ịme maka ntụgharị nkeji ikpeazụ nke Fraịde ahụ: nkwekọrịta nke Onye Ọmeiwu Jeff Flake nke Arizona zubere maka FBI iji mee nnyocha otu-izu maka ebubo ndị ahụ.

rows.output: Ford gwara Kansul Senate na-ahụ maka ikpe ziri ezi na ọ nwere 100 pasentị nchegbu na Kavanaugh metụrụ ya aka n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi ma nwaa ịkpọpụta uwe ya n'ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị.
rows.reference: Ford gwara Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu na o doro ya anya pasentị 100 na Kavanaugh ji anya mmanya pịa ya aka ma nwaa iyipu ya akwa n’emume ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndịrị.

rows.output: Kavanaugh, n'okwuchukwu na-enwe mmetụta, kwuru na o nwere 100 pasentị nchegbu na ọ bụghị ihe mere.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh, na nkwupụta nwere oke mmetụta, kwuru na o doro ya anya pasentị 100 na ọ meghị.

rows.output: Ọ ga-abụ na ihe karịrị nde 20.4 ndị mmadụ, dị ka Nielsen kwuru na Fraịde, hụrụ ya.
rows.reference: Enwere ohere na ihe karịrị ọnụọgụ nde ndị mmadụ 20.4 nke Nielsen kwuru na Friday lelere ya.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-agụpụta ndị na-ege ntị n'etiti CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel na MSNBC.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-agụ nkezi nlele na CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel na MSNBC.

rows.output: Ihe ndị a na-egosi ya na netwọkọ ndị ọzọ, gụnyere PBS, C-SPAN na Fox Business Network, adịghị ozugbo.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụgụ adịghị ozugbo maka netwọk ndị ọzọ gosiri ya, gụnyere PBS, C-SPAN na Fox Business Network.

rows.output: Na Nielsen na-enwekarị nsogbu ịtule ndị na-ekiri ihe n'ụlọ ọrụ.
rows.reference: Ma Nielsen na enwekarị nsogbu ịha ndị mmadụ lelere n’ụlọ ọrụ ha.

rows.output: Iji mee ka nke ahụ pụta ìhè, nke ahụ bụ nha ndị na-ege ntị dị ka egwuregwu bọọlụ nke asọmpi ma ọ bụ ihe nrite Academy.

rows.output: Fox News Channel, nke ndị na-eme ihe nkiri ya na-akwado nkwupụta Kavanaugh, duuru netwọkọ niile na ndị na-ege ntị 5.69 nde n'oge nyocha ahụ niile, Nielsen kwuru.
rows.reference: Fox News Channel, ndị nchịkọta ya nwere uche nke ya kwadosiri nhọpụta Kavanaugh ike, gafere netwọk niile site na ịnwe nkezi nke ọnụọgụ ndị nlele nde 5.69 n’oge ọnụnụ ụbọchị-niile ahụ, Nielsen kwuru.

rows.output: N'afọ 2017, CBS nwere nde 3.1, NBC nwere nde 2.94, MSNBC nwere nde 2.89 na CNN nwere nde 2.52, Nielsen kwuru.

rows.output: Flake bụ onye isi ihe nkiri na Fraịde.

rows.output: Mgbe ụlọ ọrụ Republican na-ahọpụta ya wepụtara nkwupụta na ọ ga-ahọpụta Kavanaugh, a hụrụ ya ka CNN na CBS na-ewute ya n'ụtụ Fraịde ka ndị na-eme ngagharị ihe na-akwa ya emo ka ọ na-agbalị ịbata n'ime ụlọ ikpe.

rows.output: Ọ nọdụrụ ala, na-ele anya n'ala, ruo ọtụtụ nkeji ka a na-ata ya ahụ, a na-agbapụta ya n'ihu ọha na CNN.

rows.output: "Ana m nọ ebe a n'ihu gị," otu nwanyị kwuru.

rows.output: Mana Flake kwuru na ọ ga-eme ya naanị n'okpuru ọnọdụ na ndị FBI ga-eleba anya n'ebubo eboro onye a họpụtara maka otu izu, nke ndị Democrats na-emegide obere na-arịọ.

rows.output: Flake kwenyesiri ike n'otu akụkụ site n'okwuchukwu ya na enyi ya, onye Sinetọ Democratic bụ Chris Coons.

rows.output: Mgbe ya na Coons kọwachara ma nwee mkparịta ụka na ndị omebe iwu ole na ole, ọ mere mkpebi ya.

rows.output: Mpaghara ndị ọzọ nke Desert Southwest, gụnyere etiti Rockies na Great Basin, nwere ike nweta sentimita 1 ruo 2, na mkpokota ndị a na-apụ apụ rute sentimita 4.
rows.reference: Mpaghara ndị ọzọ nke Ọdịda Anyanwụ na Ndịda Ọzara gụnyere etiti Rockies na Great Basin nwere ike ịnweta inchi 1 ruo 2, mgbakọta dịpụrụ iche ruru inchi 4 ma enwee ike.

rows.output: Maka ndị na-adịghị n'ihe ize ndụ nke idei mmiri, mmiri ozuzo Rosa nwere ike ịbụ ihe ọma maka mpaghara ahụ nke na-agbaze.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ahụ na anọghị n’egwu ide mmiri, mmiri ozizo nke Rosa nwere ike ịbụ ngozi ebe mpaghara ahụ na enwe nnukwu ọkọchị.

rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na idei mmiri bụ nnukwu nchegbu, akụkụ nke mmiri ozuzo a ga-adịkwa mma n'ihi na ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ na-enwe ụkọ ugbu a.
rows.reference: Agbanyeghị na ide mmiri bụ ihe nnukwu egwu, ụfọdụ mmiri ozizo a ga-adị mkpa ebe akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ na ndịda ugbu a na enwe nnukwu ọkọchị.

rows.output: Dị ka U.S. Drought Monitor si kwuo, ihe dị ka pasentị iri anọ nke Arizona na-enwe oke ọkọchị, nke bụ nke abụọ n'usọ nke kọmpat.
rows.reference: Site n’aka ndị U.S. Ihe Nyocha Ọkọchị, naanị pasentị karịrị 40 na enweta opekata mpe ọkọchị dị oke egwu, otu nke abụọ kachasị,” weather.com kpesara.

rows.output: Nke mbụ, ụzọ nke Hurricane Rosa na-eduga na ala ala n'akụkụ Baja California nke Mexico.
rows.reference: Izizi, ụzọ nke Oke Ifufe Rosa na ada n’ofe Baja California ala mmiri nke Mexico.

rows.output: Rosa, ka ọ na-adị n'ike n'ike n'ụtụ Sọnde, nwere ikuku kachasị elu nke 85 kilomita kwa elekere, dị 385 kilomita n'ebe ndịda Punta Eugenia, Mexico, na-aga n'ebe ugwu na 12 kilomita kwa elekere.
rows.reference: Rosa, ka nọrọ n’ike oke ifufe ụtụtụ Mọnde nwere ikuku kachasị nke maịlụ 85 kwa aka elekere, nọ maịlụ 385 ndịda nke Punta Eugenia, Mexico na aga n’akụkụ ugwu na maịlụ 12 kwa aka elekere.

rows.output: Oke ifufe ahụ na-ezute mmiri oyi na Pacific ma na-ebelata ike ya.
rows.reference: Ikuku mmiri ahụ na abanye mmiri jụrụ oyi na Pacifik ya mere ọ na agbatu n’ike.

rows.output: Ya mere, a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ada n'ala Mexico n'ụzọ oké ifufe n'ehihie ma ọ bụ abalị na Mọnde.
rows.reference: Ya mere, atụrụ anya na ọ ga-ada na Mexico n’ike oke ikuku mmiri n’oge ehihie ma ọ bụ mgbede na Mọnde.

rows.output: Mmiri ozuzo n'ofe akụkụ nke Mexico nwere ike ịdị arọ, na-ebute ihe ize ndụ idei mmiri dị ukwuu.
rows.reference: Mmiri ozizo n’ofe akụkụ nke Mexico nwere ike isi ike, na eyite ihe egwu nke ide mmiri.

rows.output: "Ọ dịla ihe dị ka sentimita 3 ruo 6 nke mmiri ozuzo a na-atụ anya site na Baja California gaa n'ebe ugwu ọwụwa anyanwụ Sonora, na ihe ruru sentimita 10 nwere ike ime."
rows.reference: “Atụrụ anya mgbakọta mmiri ozizo nke inchi 3 ruo 6 sitere na Baja California banye n’akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ na ugwu nke Sonora, nwere ruo inchi 10 ma enwee ike,” weather.com kpesara.

rows.output: Rosa ga-eso n'ebe ugwu n'ofe Mexico dị ka oké ifufe tupu ọ rute n'ókè Arizona n'ụtụtụ Tuesday dị ka oké ifufe, nke ga-eso n'ebe ugwu site na Arizona na n'ime ndịda Utah n'abalị Tuesday.
rows.reference: Mgbe ahụ Rosa ga-aga akụkụ ugwu site na Mexico ka oke ikuku mmiri tupu o rute n’oke ala Arizona n’isi ụtụtụ Tusde ka oke ifufe egbe-igwe, nke ga-agafe ozugbo na Arizona wee banye n’akụkụ ndịda Utah n’oge ime mgbede Tusde.

rows.output: "Ihe ize ndụ kacha mkpa a na-atụ anya site na Rosa ma ọ bụ ihe fọdụrụ ya bụ oke mmiri ozuzo na Baja California, northwestern Sonora, na U.S. Desert Southwest," National Hurricane Center kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ihe ịze ndụ kachasị atụrụ anya n’aka Rosa ma ọ bụ ihe fọdụrụ na ya bụ nnukwu mmiri ozizo dị egwu na Baja California, ọdịda anyanwụ na ugwu nke Sonora, yana U.S. Ọdịda Anyanwụ na Ndịda Ọzara,” Ọdụ Oke Ifufe Mba kwuru.

rows.output: A na-atụ anya na mmiri ozuzo ndị a ga-emepụta idei mmiri na-emerụ ndụ na ide mmiri n'ime ọhịa, na ala ala n'elu ugwu.
rows.reference: Atụrụ anya mmiri ozizo ndị a ịmepụta ịde mmiri nwere ike igbu ndị mmadụ yana ọsụsọ ahịhịa n’ọzara, yana ala ọzịze n’ala ugwu.

rows.output: Midsomer Norton attack: Anọ na-awakpo ikpe

rows.reference: Ejidela ụmụ ntorobịa nwoke atọ yana otu nwoke dị afọ 20 na nyocha nke ọnwụnwa igbu mmadụ ka ahụchara otu onye dị afọ 16 nwere ọnya eji mma mee na Somerset.

rows.output: Nwata nwoke ahụ dị afọ iri na ụma ahụ hụrụ n'ụzọ Excelsior Terrace nke Midsomer Norton, n'ihe dị ka 04:00 BST na Satọde.
rows.reference: Ahụrụ nwoke ntorobịa ahụ ebe ọ nwere ọnya n’ebe mpaghara Excelsior Terrace nke Midsomer Norton, ihe dị ka 04:00 BST na Satode.

rows.output: E bugara ya n'ụlọ ọgwụ ebe ọ ka nọ n'ọnọdụ "nchekwube".
rows.reference: Edugara ya n’ụlọ ọgwụ ebe ọ nọrọ n’ọnọdụ “dị mma”.

rows.output: Nwoke dị afọ iri na asaa, ndị ikom abụọ dị afọ iri na asatọ, na otu nwoke dị afọ iri abụọ ka e jidere n'abalị a n'ógbè Radstock, ndị uwe ojii Avon na Somerset kwuru.
rows.reference: Ejidere otu onye afọ 17, mmadụ abụọ afọ 18 yana otu nwoke afọ 20 n’abalị na mpaghara Radstock, Avon nke Ndị Uwe Ojii Somerset kwuru.

rows.output: Ndị ọrụ ahụ agwala onye ọ bụla nwere ihe onyonyo ekwentị ọ bụla nke ihe mere ka ọ bịaruo ha.
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii arịọla ka mmadụ ọ bụla nwere nseta ekwentị mkpanaka nke ihe mere ka ọ bịa ihu.

rows.output: Trump kwuru na Kavanaugh 'na-ata ahụhụ, obi ọjọọ, ihe ijuwe' nke pati Democratic
rows.reference: Trump kwuru Kavanaugh “tara ahụhụ, obi akpọ, iwe” nke Otu Demokrats

rows.output: "Vootu maka Ọkaikpe Kavanaugh bụ vootu iji jụ ndị Democratic Party na-emegbu na nke na-adịghị mma."
rows.reference: “Otu ntuli aka maka Ọkaikpe Kavanaugh bụ ntuli aka iji jụ obi ọjọọ na ụzọ gafere oke nke ndị Otu Demokrats,” Trump kwuru n’ọgbakọ dị na Wheeling, West Virginia.

rows.output: Trump kwuru na Kavanaugh enweela "iwe, iwe iwe" nke pati Democratic n'oge usoro nhọpụta ya.
rows.reference: Trump kwuru na Kavanaugh “ataala ahụhụ obi akpọ, iwe” nke ndị Otu Demokrat n’usoro nhọpụta ya.

rows.output: Kavanaugh gara n'ihu Congress na Tọzdee, na-ewusi ike na n'ụzọ mmetụta uche na-agọnarị ebubo sitere n'aka Christine Blasey Ford na ọ na-ata ahụhụ ya n'afọ iri atọ gara aga mgbe ha bụ ndị na-eto eto.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh gbara akaebe n’ihu Nzụkọ na Tọsde, jiri iwe na obi mmụọ wee gọnarị ebubo nke Christine Blasey Ford na ọ wakporo ya n’afọ iri gara aga mgbe ha bụ ndị ntorobia.

rows.output: Ford nwekwara uju n'ụlọ ikpe gbasara ebubo ya.
rows.reference: Ford gbakwara akaebe nke ọnụnụ ahụ gbasara ebubo ya.

rows.output: Onye isi ala kwuru na Satọde na ndị America hụrụ "ọmarịcha na àgwà na obi ike" nke Kavanaugh n'ụbọchị ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala kwuru na Satọde na “Ndị America hụrụ amamịghe na agwa na mgbamume” nke Kavanaugh n’ụbọchị ahụ.

rows.output: "Vootu iji kwado Ọkaikpe Kavanaugh bụ vootu ijiado otu n'ime ndị ọkà ihe ọmụma iwu kacha mma n'oge anyị, onye ọka ikpe nwere ndekọ ọrụ ọha na eze mara mma."
rows.reference: “Otu ntuli aka iji kwenye na Ọkaikpe Kavanaugh bụ otu ntuli aka iji kwenye n’otu uche iwu kachasị tozuo etozu n’oge anyị, onye ọkaiwu nwere ndekọ nke ọrụ ọhaneze na amuke amuke,” ọ gwara igwe mmadụ nke ndị nkwado West Virginia.

rows.output: Onye isi ala ahụ kwuru okwu n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi maka nhọpụta Kavanaugh mgbe ọ na-ekwu maka mkpa ndị Republican na-eme ntụli aka na ntuli aka etiti.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala ahụ iji ụzọ ọzọ wee rụtụ aka na nhọpụta Kavanaugh ka ọ na ekwu maka mkpa nke mpụta ndị Repọblikan na ntuli aka ndị etiti afọ.

rows.output: "Isi izu ise site na otu n'ime nhọrọ ndị kacha mkpa n'oge anyị.
rows.reference: “Izu ise fọdụrụ tupu otu ntuli aka kachasị mkpa na ndụ anyị.

rows.output: Anaghị m agbapụ, ma ọ na-agbapụ m n'ezie," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: Anaghị m apụta, mana m na apụta n’ezie,” o kwuru.

rows.output: "Nke ahụ bụ ihe mere m ji na-agba mbọ n'ebe niile ịlụ ọgụ maka ndị na-eme ihe dị mma."
rows.reference: “Ya mere m ji nọrọ n’ebe niile na akwado ndị anamachọihe mara oke mma.”

rows.output: Trump rụrụ ụka na ndị Democrats nọ n'ọgbọ iji "ịjịgharị na iguzogide."
rows.reference: Trump rụrụ aka na ndị Demokrats nọ na njem iji “kwụsị ma gbochido.”

rows.output: Ntụle dị mkpa nke mbụ na ala Senate maka nhọpụta Kavanaugh ka a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-eme n'oge na-adịghị anya karịa Fraịde, onye isi ndị isi GOP kwuru na CNN.
rows.reference: Ntuli aka izizi dị mkpa n’ọkwa Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu maka nhọpụta nke Kavanaugh ka atụrụ anya ga-eme tupu Fraịde gachaa, onye otu ọchịchị GOP dị elu gwara CNN.

rows.output: Puku ndị e gburu site na ọtụtụ ala ọma jijiji Indonesia, tsunami, na ọnụ ọgụgụ a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-abụriri elu
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji, tsunami, nke Indonesia gburu narị kwụrụ narị ndị mmadụ, ọgụgụ ka na agbago

rows.output: N'ụzọ dị n'etiti mmadụ 384 nwụrụ, ọtụtụ ndị eburula n'ụsọ oké osimiri ka ebili mmiri buru ibu dakwasịrị n'ụsọ oké osimiri, mgbe nnukwu ala ọma jijiji na ebili mmiri dakwasịrị n'agwaetiti Sulawesi nke Indonesia, ndị ọchịchị kwuru na Satọde.
rows.reference: Opekata mpe egburu ndị mmadụ 384, ka nnukwu ikuku dara n’akụkụ osimiri ekpochapụrụ ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ, mgbe nnukwu ala ọmajiji na tsunami kụrụ agwaetiti Indonesia nke Sulawesi, ndị ikikere kwuru na Satọde.

rows.output: N'ime ụbọchị Fraịde, ọgbọ mmadụ nọ n'ebe ahụ maka mmemme n'akụkụ osimiri n'obodo Palu, mgbe ebili mmiri dị elu nke mita isii (ụkwụ iri na asatọ) dakwasịrị n'akụkụ osimiri n'oge mgbede, na-ebuba ọtụtụ mmadụ n'ime mmiri ma na-ebibi ihe ọ bụla nọ n'ụzọ ha.
rows.reference: Narị kwụrụ narị ndị mmadụ bịakọtara maka emume n’akụkụ osimiri n’obodo nke Palu na Fraịde mgbe ikuku ruru ogo mita isii (ụkwụ 18) dara n’ala n’oge uhuruchi, zara imirikiti banye n’ọnwụ ha ma na emebi ihe ọ bụla dị n’ụzọ ya.

rows.output: Mgbaba ahụ sochiri ala ọma jijiji nke 7.5.
rows.reference: Tsunami ahụ sotere ala ọmajiji ike 7.5.

rows.output: "Ọbụrụ na ihe iyi egwu nke tsunami pụtaworo n'ụbọchị gara aga, ndị mmadụ ka na-eme ihe n'ụsọ oké osimiri ma ha eweghị ozugbo ma ha wee bụrụ ndị nwụrụ anwụ," Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, onye na-ekwu okwu maka ụlọ ọrụ Indonesia na-ahụ maka mgbochi ihe mberede BNPB kwuru n'oge nnọkọ na Jakarta.
rows.reference: “Mgbe ihe egwu tsunami ahụ bidoro ụnyahụ, ndị mmadụ nọ na eme mmemme ha n’akụkụ osimiri ahụ, ha agbaghị ọsọ ozugbo, ya mere o ji metụta ha,” Sutopo Purwo Nugrogo, okwu okwu maka ụlọ ọrụ njikwa ọdachi mba nke Indonesia BNPS kwuru na nchịkọta na Jakarta.

rows.output: "Ọ dịghị tsunami ahụ n'onwe ya, ọ kpọbatara ụgbọ ala, osisi, ụlọ, ọ kụrụ ihe niile n'ala," Nugroho kwuru, na-agbakwunye na tsunami ahụ agafeela n'oké osimiri n'ụzọ dị elu nke 800 kph (497 mph) tupu ọ kụọ n'akụkụ osimiri.
rows.reference: “Tsunami ahụ abịaghị n’aka ya, o burulu ụgbọ ala, osisi, ụlọ, ọ kụrụ ihe niile nọ n’ala,” Nugroho kwuru, na ekwukwa na tsunami ahụ gafere na nnukwu osimiri n’ọsọ nke 800 kph (497 mph) tupu o daruo n’akụkụ osimiri.

rows.output: Ụfọdụ ndị na-arị elu n'elu osisi iji zọpụta onwe ha n'ụgbọ mmiri ahụ, o kwuru.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ ndị mmadụ rịrị elu osisi iji gbanarị tsunami ahụ ma dị ndụ, o kwuru.

rows.output: N'ihe dị ka mmadụ 16,700 ebugara n'ụlọ ọrụ 24 dị na Palu.
rows.reference: Ebugara ihe ruru ndị mmadụ 16,700 n’ama 24 dị na Palu.

rows.output: Foto ikuku e wepụtaworo site n'aka ụlọ ọrụ na-ahụ maka ihe mberede gosiri ọtụtụ ụlọ na ụlọ ahịa mebiri emebi, àkwà mmiri gbawara agbawa na nke gbawara agbawa, na ụlọ ala nsọ gbara mmiri.
rows.reference: Ọsịse elu nke ụlọ ọrụ ọdachi ahụ buputere gosiri imirikiti ụlọ na ụlọ ahịa emebisiri, akwa mmiri gbagochara ma daa yana ụlọ alakụba mmiri gbara okirikiri.

rows.output: Mgbagha gara n'ihu na-akpagharị n'obodo dị n'akụkụ osimiri na Satọde.
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji gara n’ihu na eme n’ụsọ oke osimiri ahụ na Satọde.

rows.output: Mmetụta nke ala ọma jijiji ahụ dị na mpaghara nwere mmadụ nde 2.4.
rows.reference: Enwere mmetụta usoro nke ala ọmajiji na mpaghara nwere ndị mmadụ nde 2.4.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Indonesia maka nyocha na itinye teknụzụ (BPPT) kwuru na nkwupụta na ike a na-ebupụta site na nnukwu ala ọma jijiji nke Fraịde ahụ bụ ihe dị ka 200 ugboro ike bọmbụ atomik a tụbara Hiroshima n'oge Agha Ụwa nke Abụọ.
rows.reference: Ụlọ Ọrụ maka Nyocha na Ntinye nke Teknụzụ nke Indonesia (BPPT) kwuru na nkwupute na ike nnukwu ọmajiji nke Fraịde buputere dị ihe dị ka ugboro 200 nke ike nke ogbunigwe atọmik atụsara na Hiroshima na Agha Ụwa nke Abụọ.

rows.output: Ihe mere n'obodo ahụ, nke dị n'akụkụ osimiri dị ogologo, n'ụzọ dị ukwuu nwere ike ime ka oke oke mmiri ahụ dịkwuo elu, o kwuru.
rows.reference: Ala nke obodo ahụ, nke tukwu na ngwụcha nke mpaghara osimiri toro ogologo, dị warawara, nwere ike ibuwanye nha nke tsunami ahụ, ka o kwuru.

rows.output: Nugroho kọwara mmebi ahụ dị ka "nke ukwuu" ma kwuo na puku ụlọ, ụlọ ọgwụ, ụlọ ahịa, na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ dara.
rows.reference: Nugroho kọwara mmebi ahụ ka “ihe gbasara agbasa” ma kwuo puku kwụrụ puku nke ụlọ, ụlọ ọgwụ, ọdụ ụlọ ahịa na ụlọ nkwari dara.

rows.output: Mkpụrụ ahụ nke ụfọdụ ndị nwụrụ anwụ ka achọtara n'okpuru ihe ndị dara ada, o kwuru, na-agbakwunye na mmadụ 540 merụrụ ahụ na 29 na-efunarị.
rows.reference: Ahụrụ ahụ nke ụfọdụ ndị mmadụ ọ metụtara n’okpuru ahịhịa nke ụlọ ndị dara, o kwuru, tinye ndị mmadụ 540 merụrụ ahụ ma 29 na efu.

rows.output: Nugroho kwuru na ndị nwụrụ anwụ na mmebi ahụ nwere ike ịdị ukwuu n'akụkụ osimiri 300 km (190 kilomita) n'ebe ugwu nke Palu, mpaghara a na-akpọ Donggala, nke dị nso na ebe ala ọtọ nke ala ọtọ.
rows.reference: Nugroho kwuru na ndị nwụrụ yana mmebi nwere ike ịkarị n’ogologo ụsọ oke osimiri ahụ 300km (maịlụ 190) n’akụkụ ugwu nke Palu, mpaghara a na akpọ Donggala, nke nọketere nso na etiti nke ọmajiji ahụ.

rows.output: Nkwurịta okwu "nweghachiri kpamkpam na-enweghị ozi ọ bụla" site na Donggala, Nugroho kwuru.
rows.reference: Nkwukọrịta enweghị ozi ọ bụla ma ncha sitere na Donggala, Nugroho kwuru.

rows.output: Enwere ihe karịrị mmadụ 300,000 bi n'ebe ahụ," otu Red Cross kwuru na nkwupụta, na-agbakwunye na ndị ọrụ ha na ndị ọrụ ebere na-aga ebe ahụ metụtara.
rows.reference: Enwere karịa ndị mmadụ 300,000 bi ebe ahụ,” Red Cross kwuru na nkwupute, na etinye na ndị ọrụ ya na ndị wepụtara onwe ha na aga n’ebe ndị emetụtara.

rows.output: "Nke a bụ ihe mberede, ma ọ ka njọ."

rows.output: N'otu oge ahụ, China webatara atụmatụ ya n'afọ gara aga: ọ na-achọ ịbụ No.1 n'ụzọ ọhụrụ nke AI site na 2030.
rows.reference: Otu aka ọzọ, China bubatara atụmatụ ya n’afọ gara aga: ọ na achọ ịbụ onye nke 1 na mweputa ọhụrụ AI tupu 2030.

rows.output: "Abawanye ego nyocha AI okpukpu abụọ ga-abụ mmalite dị mma, na-atụle na mba ndị ọzọ niile dị nnọọ anya n'azụ U.S., na anyị na-achọ ihe ọhụrụ na AI," ka Lee kwuru.
rows.reference: “Iwegote ego nnyocha AI ugboro abụọ ga-abụ ezigbo mbido, ejiri n’aka na ndị obodo ndị ọzọ niile agateela aka ebe U.S. nọ, ma anyị na achọ ihe ịtụnanya na esote na AI,” Lee kwuru.

rows.output: Ịba ụba ego nwere ike ime ka ohere dịkwuo elu na ihe ịga nke ọma AI na-esochi ga-eme na U.S., Lee gwara CNBC n'ajụjụ ọnụ n'oge a.
rows.reference: Iwegote ego ugboro abụọ nwere ike iwegote ohere na ntozu AI buru ibu na esote ga-abụ na U.S., Lee gwara CNBC n’ajụjụ ọnụ n’izu a.

rows.output: Lee, onye akwụkwọ ya bụ "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley na New World Order" e bipụtara n'ọnwa a site na Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, bụ onye isi oche nke Sinovation Ventures, nke etinyela ego na otu n'ime ụlọ ọrụ AI kacha mara amụma na China, Face++.

rows.output: N'ime 1980s na Mahadum Carnegie Mellon, ọ rụrụ ọrụ na usoro AI nke meriri onye ọkpụkpọ Othello America kachasị elu, ma emesia ọ bụ onye isi na Microsoft Research na onye isi ala nke ngalaba Google China.

rows.output: Lee kwetara asọmpi teknụzụ gọọmentị U.S. gara aga dị ka Robotics Challenge nke Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency na jụọ mgbe nke na-esote ga-abụ, iji nyere aka chọpụta ndị na-ahụ ụzọ n'ihu.

rows.output: Ndị nchọpụta na U.S. na-arụkarị ọrụ ike iji nweta ego gọọmentị, Lee kwuru.

rows.output: "Ọ bụghị China na-eweghachi ndị isi ụlọ akwụkwọ; ọ bụ ụlọ ọrụ." Lee kwuru.

rows.output: Facebook, Google na ndị ọzọ na-eme ihe na teknụzụ enyela ndị ọkà mmụta sayensị si n'ụlọ akwụkwọ ka ha rụọ ọrụ na AI n'afọ ndị na-adịbeghị anya.
rows.reference: Facebook, Google na ụlọ ọrụ teknụzụ ndị ọzọ na ewere ndị ọkachamara na mahadum iji rụọ ọrụ na AI n’afọ nso nso a.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ sayensị nke China na-enye ego maka ndị mmadụ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ dị ka National Science Foundation na ndị ọrụ gọọmentị ndị ọzọ na-enye ego maka ndị nchọpụta US, mana àgwà ọrụ mmụta dị ala na China, Lee kwuru.
rows.reference: National Natural Science Foundation nke China na enye ndị mmadụ nọ n’ewumewu agụmakwụkwọ ego otu ụzọ nke National Science Foundation na ọgbakọ gọọmentị ndị ọzọ si enye ndị nyocha U.S. ego, mana ogo nke ọrụ agụmakwụkwọ dị ala na China, Lee kwuru.

rows.output: N'oge gara aga n'afọ a, ndị agha nchekwa U.S. hiwere ụlọ ọrụ imekọ ihe ọnụ maka ọrụ amamihe, nke e mere iji tinye ndị mmekọ site n'ụlọ ọrụ na mahadum, na White House kwuputakwara nhọpụta kọmiti na-arụ ọrụ na ọrụ amamihe.

rows.output: Greece, nke nwere ógbè a na-akpọ Macedonia, na-ekwu na aha ógbè ya na-eme ka ọ bụrụ na ọ na-achọ ala ya ma na-egbochi ka ọ bata na NATO na EU.

rows.output: Gọọmentị abụọ ahụ kwenyere n'ụzọ dị n'etiti June, dabere na aha ọhụrụ a tụrụ aro, mana ndị na-emegide ọchịchị na-ekwu na mgbanwe ahụ ga-emerụ njirimara agbụrụ nke ndị Slav na-achị Macedonia.

rows.output: Onye isi ala Gjorge Ivanov ekwupụtala na ọ gaghị eme ntụli aka na ntụli aka ahụ, ma otu ndị na-akwado ịghara ịtụpụta ihe mere ka a na-enwe nchegbu ma ọ bụ na ọ ga-ezute ihe kacha nta nke 50 pasentị achọrọ maka ntụli aka ahụ ka ọ bụrụ nke a na-anabata.

rows.output: "Abịara m taa ịtụ vootu maka ọdịnihu obodo, maka ndị na-eto eto na Macedonia ka ha nwee ike ibi n'efu n'okpuru umbrella nke European Union n'ihi na ọ pụtara ndụ dị nche maka anyị niile," ka Olivera Georgijevska, 79, kwuru na Skopje.
